stories.title: John Morrison Compares Management Style of Tony Khan, Vince McMahon, and Triple H
stories.tldr: During a recent interview following his championship victory in India, veteran wrestler John Morrison compared the leadership styles of Vince McMahon, Triple H, and Tony Khan. Morrison noted that while Vince McMahon operated with absolute financial freedom and zero checks and balances, Triple H faces tighter corporate restrictions under the TKO umbrella. He also drew comparisons between McMahon and AEW President Tony Khan, highlighting Khan's relentless work ethic and passion for the industry while remarking that Khan is a lot like Vince except with a good heart.

stories.title: Steven Borden Discusses Sting's Retirement and His Own Wrestling Journey
stories.tldr: Steven Borden recently opened up about his unexpected path to professional wrestling, noting that his legendary father Sting initially steered him away from the industry to pursue other paths like football. However, getting involved in Sting's retirement match at AEW Revolution 2024 inspired Steven to stop running from his own calling and finally step into the ring. Now preparing for a major tag team match at AEW All Out alongside Darby Allin, Steven has been pleasantly surprised by the overwhelmingly generous and positive reactions from fans both in arenas and online.

stories.title: Dax Harwood Praises AEW Tag Team Division and Partnership With Stokely Hathaway
stories.tldr: Dax Harwood of FTR recently declared that All Elite Wrestling is undeniably the premier home for tag team wrestling, pointing to an influx of legendary tandems and rising young talent. Harwood highlighted the star-studded roster featuring FTR, The Young Bucks, Cope and Cage, the Motor City Machine Guns, and The New Level, rivaling any era in the past thirty years. Additionally, Harwood and Cash Wheeler praised their ongoing on-screen and backstage partnership with manager Stokely Hathaway, revealing that Harwood originally pitched Hathaway to Tony Khan as their modern-day Jim Cornette. The duo noted that this alliance could potentially last for the remainder of FTR's career as they continue to navigate a booming tag team division.

stories.title: Julia Hart to Face Fuwa-chan at STARDOM Korakuen Hall Event
stories.tldr: Celebrity wrestler Fuwa-chan is set to face AEW star Julia Hart in a high-stakes singles match at STARDOM’s upcoming Korakuen Hall event in Tokyo on September 29. This booking stems from recent tension, as Fuwa-chan and her partners previously challenged Hart and her Triangle of Madness stablemates for the Artist of Stardom Championship, a request the champions have yet to accept. The stacked card also features a championship defense, an AEW-connected four-way tag match involving Maki Itoh, and various other marquee bouts impacting the promotion's divisions.

stories.title: Tony Khan Announces Details for AEW Worlds End PPV
stories.tldr: AEW CEO Tony Khan has confirmed that the Worlds End pay-per-view will take place in December 2026, clearing up uncertainty after the event was initially missing from the announced calendar. During the All Out media call, Khan stated that the show will once again serve as the grand finale for the Continental Classic tournament. While the exact date and location have not yet been revealed, fans can expect official announcements regarding the venue in the near future.

stories.title: Darby Allin Discusses His In-Ring Style and High Risks
stories.tldr: Darby Allin recently defended his relentless, high-risk in-ring style by explaining that he refuses to phone it in during his matches. He believes that taking an off night is unacceptable because both fans and backstage peers will immediately notice a lack of effort. Rejecting advice to save his best performances for major events, Allin treats every weekly television broadcast like a pay-per-view. Looking ahead, he is scheduled to team with Steven Borden at All Out in Chicago to face Kyle Fletcher and Kevin Knight for a shot at the AEW Tag Team titles.

stories.title: Hangman Adam Page Auctions Ring Gear for Charity
stories.tldr: AEW star Hangman Adam Page is auctioning off his signature ring gear for a good cause during a live stream event. He will put up the famous fire britches he wore during his match against Bryan Danielson at the 2024 Owen Hart Foundation Men's Tournament Final. The proceeds from his items will benefit the Clean Air Task Force to help combat climate change.

stories.title: MJF Reflects on Personal Character and Relationship With Fans
stories.tldr: Former AEW World Champion MJF recently reflected on the hard lessons learned during his historic first title reign. Speaking in a new interview tied to his No. 1 ranking in the 2026 PWI 500, he admitted that letting his guard down and opening up to wrestling fans was a massive mistake. The collapse of his friendship and on-screen partnership with Adam Cole deeply hardened his views on trust within the industry. Moving forward, MJF intends to strictly maintain a boundary between his personal life and the audience, preferring to be judged solely on his business metrics and in-ring performance.

stories.title: Thunder Rosa Reflects on Viral 2018 Training Video With Mia Khalifa
stories.tldr: Thunder Rosa recently reflected on her famous 2018 training session and video with former adult film star and influencer Mia Khalifa. The unexpected collaboration happened after Khalifa publicly criticized professional wrestling, prompting Rosa to invite her to learn the ropes and attend an independent show in Austin. According to Rosa, Khalifa proved to be gracious and supportive during the event by bringing friends and selling tickets. Today, Rosa notes that the memorable training footage still manages to go viral on the internet about four times a year.

stories.title: Thekla Comments on Missing AEW All In Event
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Thekla recently opened up about her disappointment regarding missing out on a main card match at AEW All In 2026 at Wembley Stadium. Although she appeared on the Buy In pre-show, she admitted that wrestling in front of nearly 50,000 fans in Europe would have been the biggest opportunity of her career. Despite feeling upset, she balanced her perspective by reflecting on her successful run and the value of keeping fans wanting more. She is now focused on her upcoming return to pay-per-view action at AEW All Out 2026, where she will face Willow Nightingale for a future title shot.

stories.title: Maya World AEW Injury and Surgery Status Update
stories.tldr: Former TBS Champion Maya World is currently sidelined following an undisclosed medical procedure unrelated to an in-ring injury. While initial backstage estimates suggested a two-month recovery, social media banter with Britt Baker hints she could be back sooner. The absence also forced World to withdraw from a scheduled independent booking earlier this month.

stories.title: Persephone Open Challenge Opponent for AEW All Out
stories.tldr: Former TNA star Dani Luna is reportedly set to make her AEW debut as the mystery opponent answering Persephone's TBS Championship open challenge at All Out. Meanwhile, rumors regarding Kairi Sane appearing at the event have been shut down due to lack of a signed contract. Maya World, Hyan, and Thunder Rosa have also been officially ruled out of the championship match.

stories.title: Backstage Status Updates on Free Agents Rumored for AEW
stories.tldr: Ahead of AEW All Out, backstage updates have clarified the status of several rumored free agents and roster members. Former TNA standout Dani Luna has officially signed with the company and is expected to debut soon. Meanwhile, Kairi Sane and Sheamus have been ruled out as surprise event appearances due to ongoing contract talks and lingering WWE obligations, while Maya World faces a multi-month absence following a medical procedure.

stories.title: MJF Ranked No. 1 on PWI 500 and Praises Trick Williams and Oba Femi
stories.tldr: Following his top placement on the Pro Wrestling Illustrated 500 list, MJF has shared his candid thoughts on several WWE stars who joined him in the upper echelon of the rankings. He singled out rising talents Trick Williams and Oba Femi for their immense potential, sharing personal encounters with Williams. MJF also addressed Gunther, admitting he is still bitter about the star retiring John Cena while praising his in-ring toughness.

stories.title: AEW All Out Predictions and Analysis
stories.tldr: Penta has emerged as the internal favorite to win the upcoming Men's Money in the Bank ladder match following a major creative shift. Alongside this WWE news, analysts are breaking down predictions for the AEW All Out pay-per-view event. Discussions also cover potential upcoming Money in the Bank participants and the modern effectiveness of storyline kidnapping angles like the one involving Solo Sikoa.

stories.title: Uncertainty Surrounding Future of WWE Evolve Brand
stories.tldr: Questions have emerged regarding the long-term future of the WWE Evolve developmental brand following recent programming and contract developments. The concerns were heightened when WWE announced that Main Event will begin streaming on Rumble on Wednesdays at 8 p.m. ET, putting it in direct competition with Evolve existing time slot on Tubi. Additionally, industry observers note that WWE has already banked enough Evolve episodes to last through early February with no new tapings scheduled, while multiple WWE ID contracts are reportedly approaching their expiration dates. Despite the behind-the-scenes speculation and unusual scheduling overlap, WWE has not officially announced any changes or an impending cancellation for the Evolve series.

stories.title: Rumor Roundup: TKO Management on WWE Title Changes
stories.tldr: Recent reports clarify that TKO upper management does not interfere in weekly WWE creative decisions or individual championship reigns. While there were mixed internal feelings regarding Sami Zayn defeating CM Punk to win the Undisputed WWE Championship, TKO remains entirely focused on macro-level financial and business deals. Executives have expressed no positive or negative opinions on Zayn holding the title, leaving day-to-day booking entirely up to Triple H and the creative team.

stories.title: Xelina (Zelina Vega) Opens Up About Final Months in WWE
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Xelina, previously known as Zelina Vega, recently discussed her departure from the company and her state of mind during her final months. Speaking on a podcast, she admitted that she was miserable toward the end of her run and has noticed a stark difference in her happiness levels now. She also issued a fierce warning to online trolls, threatening to completely tear apart the physical appearance of anyone leaving her negative comments. Following her exit in April and a brief hiatus, Xelina recently returned to the ring at HOG Fall Out to pick up a victory.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Review and Broadcast Information
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on September 25, 2026, emanated from the Gainbridge Fieldhouse in Indianapolis with a start time of 8pm Eastern and global broadcasts across multiple time zones. The show uniquely kicked off with a steel cage match where Trick Williams defended the United States Championship against Baron Corbin, featuring outside involvement from Lil Yachty. The card also hosted high-stakes Money in the Bank qualifying matches, highlighted by CM Punk and Lash Legend securing their spots in their respective ladder matches.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes Character Direction in WWE
stories.tldr: As tension escalates following his recent loss to Randy Orton, Cody Rhodes has reached a critical crossroads in his WWE career. Whispers of a darker persona, comparisons to the Death of Superman storyline, and his ongoing hesitation to deliver a definitive punt kick have fueled speculation about a potential heel turn or a renewed chase for the Undisputed WWE Championship. With multiple paths ahead including the Money in the Bank ladder match and high-profile feuds with stars like CM Punk and Sami Zayn, WWE now has the opportunity to execute a nuanced character shift that was previously attempted in AEW.

stories.title: Becky Lynch WWE Character and Storyline Changes
stories.tldr: Becky Lynch has officially shifted back to a babyface role on the WWE RAW internal roster following her return after SummerSlam 2026. Her alignment had been heavily blurred since her heel turn following WrestleMania 41, where she betrayed Lyra Valkyria and engaged in high-profile feuds alongside Seth Rollins. The recent shift stems from her involvement in the Liv Morgan and Stephanie Vaquer storyline, culminating in Lynch serving as a guest referee in Chile and costing Morgan the Women's World Championship. Despite this internal status update, Lynch is expected to maintain her trademark outspoken and edgy persona as she continues to pursue championship gold.

stories.title: Bret Hart Shares Backstage Stories From WrestleMania 9
stories.tldr: Bret Hart recently opened up about his immense frustration following his WWE Championship loss to Yokozuna at WrestleMania 9, revealing that Yokozuna abruptly cut out his entire planned comeback during the match. Believing someone backstage may have manipulated Yokozuna into shortening the sequence, a furious Hart returned to the dressing room and punched a wall, accidentally striking a nail and injuring his hand. To make matters worse, Hulk Hogan then walked into the room carrying the championship belt to thank Hart and promise future business.

stories.title: Six-Woman Tag Team Match Added to WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: WWE has added a star-studded six-woman tag team match to tonight's episode of SmackDown from Indianapolis, featuring four current champions. Interim WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green teams with Tiffany Stratton and Paige to face Fatal Influence members Jacy Jayne, Fallon Henley, and Lainey Reid. The high-stakes bout is directly tied to the upcoming Money in the Bank pay-per-view, where qualifying matches are continuing.

stories.title: Charlotte Flair Podcast Gesture Emotional Response
stories.tldr: Natalya recently revealed on radio that her husband, WWE producer TJ Wilson, was brought to near tears after recording an episode for Charlotte Flair's new podcast. Flair presented Wilson with a bouquet of flowers and a heartfelt note detailing his immense impact on her career and the company's women's division. The touching gesture deeply moved Wilson, who has spent years coaching and training top wrestling talent behind the scenes.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown Digital Exclusives
stories.tldr: Following the latest episode of SmackDown, several digital exclusive vignettes aired on social media to set up new feuds and tensions across the roster. Shinsuke Nakamura and Kyoki targeted the MFTs and Haku over interference, while The Miz and Kit Wilson found themselves blocked by the same group while seeking opportunities. Elsewhere, Ricky Saints stirred up trouble between Fraxiom and The War Raiders, and Tatum Paxley shared MITB qualifying match news that rubbed Charlotte Flair, Alexa Bliss, and others the wrong fazer the wrong way.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton Reaction to Entrance Cut on SmackDown
stories.tldr: Tiffany Stratton experienced a noticeable moment of adjustment when part of her entrance was cut during the September 25 broadcast of SmackDown. A viral ringside clip captured her realization as a cameraman asked her to wait, causing her smile to briefly fade before she professionally pivoted to entertain the live crowd. Fans online reacted strongly to the moment, praising her positive attitude while reigniting common complaints about commercial breaks interrupting televised entrances.

stories.title: Fallon Henley Receives Birthday Jokes From WWE Fans
stories.tldr: WWE star Fallon Henley celebrated her 32nd birthday while simultaneously being flooded with potato-themed jokes from fans. Fellow wrestler Tatum Paxley initiated the fun by encouraging her social media followers to spam Henley with tater tot references, stemming from their ongoing online rivalry involving tater tots and tacos. Alongside the playful trolling, both wrestlers continue to stay busy with major storylines and upcoming matches on WWE television.

stories.title: Argument for WWE to Bring Back the Divas Championship
stories.tldr: An opinion piece argues that WWE should bring back the Divas Championship to celebrate the fun, character-driven presentation currently thriving on the SmackDown roster. Performers like Chelsea Green and groups like Fatal Influence demonstrate that modern female wrestlers can successfully blend glamorous entertainment and comedy with empowerment. By shedding the negative stigma of the past, WWE can embrace a nostalgic and joyful division led by highly entertaining personalities.

stories.title: WWE NXT Star Kendal Grey Reacts to Edited Fan Photo
stories.tldr: WWE NXT star Kendal Grey recently reacted on social media to an edited fan photo that noticeably exaggerated her backside. Grey playfully acknowledged the altered image on X while remaining sidelined from in-ring action. She is currently recovering from an ear injury and vertigo issues sustained during matches earlier this summer. Her return timeline remains uncertain as she continues to deal with vestibular complications.

stories.title: Former WWE NXT Talent Edris Enofe Apologizes After Boxing Press Conference Incident
stories.tldr: Former WWE NXT talent Edris Enofe, now competing as ENA, issued a public apology after a bizarre incident at a Misfits Boxing press conference where he slapped his opponent, Bobby, with a burger. ENA expressed deep shame over his actions, admitting that the stunt does not reflect his true character outside of fight promotion. He apologized directly to his opponent, urged him to keep things professional moving forward, and wished him luck ahead of the weigh-ins for their upcoming bout.

stories.title: Reported WWE Tag Team Division Re-Signings
stories.tldr: Amid ongoing criticism regarding the state of the WWE tag team division in 2026, speculation has grown surrounding potential contract renewals and high-profile acquisitions. The company is reportedly eyeing several notable names to bolster its ranks, including internal talents nearing contract expirations and prominent tag teams from other promotions. Potential targets range from rising stars and established independent veterans to legendary acts looking for a final run.

stories.title: Stephanie McMahon Recalls Death Threats Received During Heel Run
stories.tldr: Former WWE executive and on-screen personality Stephanie McMahon recently revealed that she received death threats from fans during her time playing an antagonist character. Speaking on the What’s Your Story show with Lash Legend, McMahon reflected on the extreme backlash she faced while serving as one of the promotion's top villains. Legend noted that such intense reactions actually proved how effectively McMahon performed her job, a sentiment McMahon readily agreed with. The conversation highlighted the persistent issue of wrestling fans blurring the lines between scripted television personas and real-life individuals.

stories.title: Ari Emanuel Memoir Details Vince McMahon WWE Exit
stories.tldr: TKO Group Holdings CEO Ari Emanuel details Vince McMahon's dramatic departures from WWE in his new memoir, Roll the Calls. The book covers Emanuel learning about the initial Wall Street Journal hush money allegations at Wimbledon in 2022, which ultimately led to the creation of TKO through a merger with UFC. Emanuel also addresses the subsequent January 2024 bombshell lawsuit filed by Janel Grant, describing the allegations as horrifying and explaining how he and Mark Shapiro immediately forced McMahon out permanently.

stories.title: Expected WWE Main Roster Call-Ups After Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: Following the Money in the Bank 2026 premium live event, WWE is expected to refresh the Raw and SmackDown rosters with new talent from NXT. Reports indicate that NXT Women's Champion Kelani Jordan is positioned for a main roster move as soon as her current title reign concludes. Meanwhile, former NXT Champion Tony D'Angelo has wrapped up his storied run on the developmental brand and is primed for a long-overdue transition to the main roster.

stories.title: Sin Cara Open to Potential WWE Return
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Sin Cara recently revealed that he is open to returning to the company for another run portraying his iconic masked character. Reflecting on his initial departure in 2019 when he felt stuck and unvalued, he noted that age and maturity have given him a completely different perspective on his career. While no official talks are currently underway, he frequently thinks about the possibility and believes that in the wrestling world, anything is possible.

stories.title: Seth Rollins Returns to Host NFL Network's Good Morning Football
stories.tldr: WWE Superstar Seth Rollins is returning to the NFL Network to serve as a co-host on Good Morning Football for the 2026 NFL season. The lifelong Chicago Bears fan will appear during the September 28 road broadcast when his hometown team hosts the Philadelphia Eagles. Meanwhile, in his wrestling career, Rollins has recently returned to the ring on a South American tour following his World Heavyweight Championship match against Roman Reigns at SummerSlam.

stories.title: Brooke Hogan Discusses Relationship With Father Hulk Hogan
stories.tldr: Brooke Hogan recently opened up about her famously complicated relationship with her father, Hulk Hogan. She revealed that a major turning point occurred after he slept with her best friend, Christiane Plante, which permanently altered their dynamic and trust. Following her parents divorce and years of mounting dysfunction, fame, and unresolved hurt, the family structure ultimately collapsed under the pressure. Brooke emphasizes that public perception often oversimplifies famous families into heroes and villains, noting that she can deeply love her father while still honestly acknowledging the profound pain he caused.

stories.title: John Morrison Praises Kit Wilson
stories.tldr: Former WWE star John Morrison recently heaped high praise on Pretty Deadlys Kit Wilson while discussing his own storied career in tag team wrestling. Morrison reflected on his legendary partnership with The Miz, calling him one of the best performers of all time and highlighting his unique blend of goofy entertainment and in-ring value. He also joked that if Wilson continues to train and stay motivated, he might eventually become almost as good as Morrison himself. Furthermore, Morrison opened up about the evolution of his mentorship dynamic with The Miz and touched upon his experiences working under different wrestling regimes including Vince McMahon, Tony Khan, and the current TKO era led by Triple H.

stories.title: John Cena Florida Real Estate Property Valuation
stories.tldr: WWE legend John Cena has seen a massive increase in the value of his longtime Florida residence, which he originally purchased for $525,000 in January 2005. Located in a gated community near Tampa, the property is now estimated to be worth around $4 million following extensive renovations. Over the past two decades, Cena transformed the traditional colonial-style home into a heavily customized estate featuring luxury amenities like an indoor pool house, a home theater, and a large garage for his car collection.

stories.title: WWE Money in the Bank 2026 Qualifying Matches on SmackDown
stories.tldr: CM Punk and Lash Legend officially punched their tickets to the Money in the Bank ladder matches following hard-fought victories on SmackDown. The final qualifying spots were subsequently announced for next week, featuring Cody Rhodes, Kevin Owens, and Johnny Gargano for the men, alongside Tiffany Stratton, Tatum Paxley, and Candice LeRae for the women. Additionally, a backstage altercation has officially booked Giulia against Blake Monroe for the upcoming show.

stories.title: WWE Broadcast Plans for WWE x AAA Worlds Collide Opposite AEW All Out
stories.tldr: WWE has officially resolved the broadcast mystery surrounding the upcoming Worlds Collide event in Chicago. Rather than airing live on Saturday opposite AEW All Out, the show will be taped and premiere exclusively on YouTube next Wednesday, September 30 at 7 p.m. ET. This unique rollout means fans will see the action four days after it happens live in the arena, with the broadcast starting just one hour before AEW Dynamite.

stories.title: Trick Williams Retains US Title Against Baron Corbin in SmackDown Steel Cage Match
stories.tldr: Trick Williams successfully defended his United States Championship against Baron Corbin inside a brutal steel cage on SmackDown, overcoming interference from Lil Yachty and a historic kickout. The grueling rubber match ended after Williams delivered a succession of Book Ends to finally put Corbin away. Following his victory, Williams now turns his attention toward the upcoming Money in the Bank ladder match.

stories.title: Chad Gable Defends Intercontinental Championship on NXT and Praises Unplanned SummerSlam Moment With Penta
stories.tldr: Continuing his comments on winning the Intercontinental Championship, Chad Gable revealed that Penta delivered a deeply emotional and completely unplanned sign of respect at SummerSlam by placing the belt around his waist. Gable is now taking that championship on the road to defend it outside of regular television. He is scheduled to put the title on the line against Saquon Shugars at an NXT live event in South Carolina.

stories.title: WWE Moving Forward With Saudi Arabia Events Despite Security Concerns
stories.tldr: WWE is facing growing internal concern and discussion regarding its upcoming events in Saudi Arabia amid ongoing Middle East conflicts. Despite the tension, the company is moving forward with Crown Jewel on November 7 and is currently locking in confidential plans for WrestleMania 43 in Riyadh. Officials have held meetings at WWE headquarters to discuss logistics and are maintaining contingency plans involving private security experts.

stories.title: Drew McIntyre Resumes In-Ring Training Ahead of WWE Return
stories.tldr: Drew McIntyre has taken a major step toward his eventual WWE return by resuming in-ring training sessions. The Scottish star shared footage of himself running the ropes in Nashville as speculation builds regarding his TV comeback. While he remains without an official return date or confirmed involvement in upcoming events like Money in the Bank, his preparations are ramping up following the completion of his recent film projects.

stories.title: Karrion Kross Criticizes the Creative and Commercial Direction of Modern Wrestling
stories.tldr: MLW World Champion Killer Kross recently spoke out against the increasing commercialization and ad-heavy format of modern professional wrestling programming. During a recent interview, he criticized promotions for sacrificing match and story time in favor of constant advertisements, treating broadcast airtime like corporate real estate. Because of this uncertain trajectory, Kross declined to name a single wrestler who will carry the future of the sport.

stories.title: Card Updates and Confirmed Entrants for WWE Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: The fields for both the men and women Money in the Bank ladder matches at the upcoming premium live event are mostly finalized with several standout entrants. Confirmed names for the men include Bron Breakker, JeVon Evans, Trick Williams, PENTA, and CM Punk, while the women's side features Lola Vice, Sol Ruca, Jacy Jayne, Roxanne Perez, and Lash Legend. In addition to the ladder matches, potential card updates suggest a Women World Title triple threat involving Stephanie Vaquer, Liv Morgan, and Becky Lynch, alongside rumors of a return for Drew McIntyre.

stories.title: Randy Orton Comments on Future Following Money in the Bank Loss
stories.tldr: Despite missing out on the Money in the Bank ladder match, Randy Orton remains fixated on securing his 15th world championship. During a recent interview with Michael Cole on SmackDown, Orton set his sights squarely on Undisputed WWE Champion Cody Rhodes. Orton criticized Rhodes for constantly changing his persona over the years while boasting that he himself has never changed. The Viper warned that he is willing to do despicable things to earn another title shot against his former friend.

stories.title: Matt Cardona Reflects on Being Released by WWE
stories.tldr: Matt Cardona recently reflected on his 2020 WWE release, calling it the best day of his life because it forced him to reinvent himself. After spending 15 years with the company, Cardona ventured to the independent circuit to build a completely new persona away from his old character. He credits the firing with allowing him to travel the world with his wife, Chelsea Green, and ultimately find his true identity before eventually returning to the promotion.

stories.title: Rumors of Enzo Amore and Big Cass Returning to WWE
stories.tldr: While Big Cass has already returned to the WWE roster for an underwhelming singles run, Enzo Amore's contractual status with the company remains unconfirmed. Speculation continues to swirl regarding how WWE might eventually bring Amore back into the fold. Creative paths for his return range from a solo run in NXT to a main roster confrontation with Cass or even a surprise 2027 Royal Rumble appearance.

stories.title: Janel Grant Allegations and Vince McMahon Controversies
stories.tldr: Former WWE employee Janel Grant previously made headlines for expressing forgiveness toward Vince McMahon after their high-profile legal battle concluded. However, her recent media appearances have drawn sharp criticism from former wrestling star Shelly Martinez. Martinez publicly questioned Grant's credibility and motives, suggesting she has a hidden agenda and is attempting to build a public career out of the controversy.

stories.title: Speculation on Active WWE Stars for Future Hall of Fame Classes
stories.tldr: As speculation builds for the 2027 WWE Hall of Fame ceremony, observers have expanded their lists of potential inductees beyond previously rumored headliners like John Cena and Umaga. New discussions point toward active personnel and returning talent, including longtime announcer Michael Cole, recently returned star AJ Lee, and current on-screen fixture Haku. These potential nods would continue WWE's rare precedent of honoring major contributors while they are still actively involved with the company.

stories.title: WWE Main Roster Champions Set to Appear on NXT
stories.tldr: Saquon Shugars is officially challenging Chad Gable for the Intercontinental Championship at upcoming NXT live events. Beyond this match, rumors indicate that other main roster champions might bring their titles to the developmental brand. Stars like United States Champion Trick Williams and WWE Women's Champion Chelsea Green are heavily discussed as potential crossover visitors. This influx of main roster talent highlights a unique bridge between the developmental division and the global stage.

stories.title: WWE Management Reported Mixed Feelings on Sami Zayn Title Reign
stories.tldr: Sami Zayn recently captured the Undisputed WWE Championship for the second time this year amidst chaotic circumstances. Following his controversial first defense against Kevin Owens, reports have emerged that WWE officials hold mixed feelings regarding his current reign. The surprise title change was reportedly orchestrated to set up a marquee champion versus champion match against Roman Reigns at Crown Jewel. Meanwhile, TKO executives are said to be unconcerned with day-to-day title reigns, focusing instead on broader business deals.

stories.title: Passings of Wrestling Figures Babe Face and Jose 'Jacobs' Trujillo
stories.tldr: The wrestling world is mourning the loss of two distinct figures from different generations and scenes. José Guadalupe Fuentes Ochoa, known as the veteran Mexican lucha libre star Babe Face, has passed away at the age of 79. Simultaneously, Maryland Championship Wrestling announced the tragic passing of young independent wrestler Jose Jacobs Trujillo at just 30 years old. Tributes have poured in from promotions and legends alike, honoring the legacies and lives of both men.

stories.title: Love Pro Wrestling Host Event at Art Gallery of Alberta
stories.tldr: Edmonton-based Love Pro Wrestling is expanding its reach by partnering with the Art Gallery of Alberta for a historic afternoon event titled LPW x AGA: The Joy of Grappling on November 7. The unique showcase will feature live wrestling alongside major exhibitions celebrating local Stampede Wrestling history through portraits and photography. Meanwhile, the promotion is preparing for LPW 52: Love's Shack on September 25, which will be headlined by a high-stakes three-way match for the LPW Grand Championship. Reigning undisputed champion TY Jackson will defend his title against Marz the Specialist and Michael Richard Blais, both of whom earned their opportunities following inconclusive finishes in previous encounters with the champion.

stories.title: Mystery Wrestling Launches Talent Booking Initiative for Canadian Wrestlers
stories.tldr: Mystery Wrestling has launched a new talent booking initiative spearheaded by founder Evil Uno to help Canadian wrestlers secure international bookings, particularly in the United States. The program features 25 signed wrestlers and tag teams who are now eligible for cross-border work, effectively navigating strict visa requirements that have historically penalized unauthorized workers. Promoters can submit inquiries through a dedicated page on the promotion website for shows in Canada, the United States, and Europe. This initiative also paves the way for these talents to appear at Mystery Wrestling upcoming debut U.S. event at the historic 2300 Arena in Philadelphia.

stories.title: Santino Marella Bars Nic Nemeth and Leon Slater Before TNA Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: TNA Director of Authority Santino Marella has issued a strict no-contact order between TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth and challenger Leon Slater following a chaotic brawl on television. The ruling dictates that Nic will be stripped of his title and Slater will lose his championship opportunity if either man attacks the other before their scheduled match. Slater earned this high-stakes opportunity at Bound For Glory by relinquishing the X-Division Championship through Option C. The pay-per-view event is set to take place on October 11 in Tampa, Florida.

stories.title: Rohan Raja Attacks Andrade El Idolo at Maple Leaf Pro
stories.tldr: Rohan Raja launched a shocking sneak attack on Andrade El Idolo during an episode of Maple Leaf Pro Mayhem by disguising himself as the luchador Capitan Suicida. After Andrade won his main event match against Karl Anderson, the fake Suicida pretended to offer backup before revealing his true identity and blindsiding his rival. This cunning betrayal heavily intensifies the feud between Raja and Andrade as they prepare for their upcoming singles match at the Northern Rising event in Toronto.

stories.title: Bryan Rose Hall of Fame Column
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Hall of Fame voting season has arrived, prompting voters like Bryan Rose to share their ballots and reasoning for various candidates. In the first part of his column, Rose highlights past near-misses and deserving candidates including Junkyard Dog, the Von Erich brothers, the Briscoe Brothers, and the Hardy Boyz. He also expresses shock over Becky Lynch's low vote percentage last year, arguing that her monumental impact on women's wrestling makes her an essential Hall of Famer.

stories.title: JBL Compares AAA Star to Eddie Guerrero
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer John Bradshaw Layfield recently praised AAA star Daga, comparing his in-ring style and charismatic promo ability to the legendary Eddie Guerrero. Speaking on the Something To Wrestle podcast, JBL highlighted Daga's rockstar presence and ability to connect with audiences regardless of language barriers. Daga currently leads the reformed Los Perros del Mal faction, which has been making waves in AAA by capturing championships and feuding with top talent. Fans will get to see Daga and stablemate Berto face the Lucha Brothers this weekend at WWE X AAA Worlds Collide in Chicago.

stories.title: Steve Maclin Explains Personal Feud With Adam Copeland Ahead of Maple Leaf Pro Event
stories.tldr: Steve Maclin has intentionally made his upcoming marquee match against Adam Copeland at Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling's Northern Rising deeply personal by attacking him on AEW Dynamite. Maclin explained that his goal is to force Copeland to focus solely on their encounter and bring back the ferocious intensity of his iconic Rated-R Superstar persona. Refusing to view the bout as a sentimental homecoming, Maclin believes he has everything to gain and guarantees that fans will witness the absolute best version of both competitors on October 3.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling Title Changes Historical Retrospective
stories.tldr: September 25 holds a historically significant place in professional wrestling with approximately 265 major title changes recorded on this date across various promotions. Notable events range from classic NWA and WWF championship changes to infamous moments like Vince Russo capturing the WCW World Heavyweight Title in 2000. Modern milestones on this date include Roman Reigns winning the WWE United States Championship in 2016 and multiple title shifts in promotions like Noah and CMLL.

stories.title: CMLL Noche de Campeones Title Matches
stories.tldr: Following the CMLL Noche de Campeones event, several historic championship reigns came to an end. Hera and Olympia captured the Women's National Tag Team Titles, ending a 931-day reign by Skadi and Kira. Additionally, Vegas Depredador and Rey Pegasus claimed the National Light Heavyweight and Middleweight Championships respectively.

stories.title: TNA News Updates and Bound for Glory Ticket Sales Status
stories.tldr: Following recent television developments, TNA has finalized several major matches for Bound for Glory while ticket sales for the upcoming pay-per-view remain sluggish. The live episode of iMPACT featured major faction shakeups within Order 4, a backstage appearance by legend Hernandez, and Indi Hartwell securing a Knockouts Championship opportunity. Meanwhile, ticket distribution at the Yuengling Center in Tampa has barely moved over the last several days.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling NOAH N-1 Victory Tournament News
stories.tldr: As the N-1 Victory tournament heads toward its October 4 final, undefeated leader Kaito Kiyomiya prepares to face Yuki Iino in Sendai. Meanwhile, GHC Heavyweight Champion Tetsuya Naito has stirred controversy by publicly criticizing NOAH attendance numbers and challenging the roster to show more fire. Additionally, a mysterious masked attacker targeted GHC National Champion Naomichi Marufuji during a recent event.

stories.title: Avery Styles Added to Call Your Shot Gauntlet at TNA Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: Avery Styles has officially been added to the Call Your Shot Gauntlet match at TNA Bound for Glory. Frankie Kazarian announced the booking during a backstage segment on TNA iMPACT. This marks the second confirmed participant for the multi-person bout, following Bear Bronson.

stories.title: MJF Tops 2026 PWI 500 Rankings Ahead of Cody Rhodes and CM Punk
stories.tldr: AEW star MJF has captured the number one spot on the 36th annual Pro Wrestling Illustrated 500 list for 2026, making a massive jump from his thirtieth-place ranking the previous year. He edged out former two-year reigning top wrestler Cody Rhodes who finished second and CM Punk who claimed third place. During an interview addressing the achievement and his online critics, MJF vowed to heavily promote his top ranking upon his eventual return to television. Meanwhile, Roman Reigns missed the list entirely due to failing to meet the minimum singles match requirements during the evaluation period.

stories.title: Bryan & Vinny Show Recaps AEW Dynamite, Collision, and WWE NXT
stories.tldr: Recent wrestling audio shows and subscriber reports have provided extensive coverage of a notably lengthy block of AEW programming combining Dynamite and Collision. Reviewers described the broadcast as a daunting and very long saga that served as a go-home show before an overrun. Meanwhile, NXT received contrasting praise for delivering a quite great show, highlighted by a standout thirty-minute segment in the late-night window.

stories.title: AEW Roster Debates: Replacing MJF, Free Agent Signings, and Top Stars
stories.tldr: Recent wrestling discussions highlight major landscape shifts in All Elite Wrestling, including PWI 500 rankings debates about who might eventually succeed MJF as the top star. Meanwhile, the promotion has brought in a wave of impactful 2026 free agent signings like Tommaso Ciampa, Persephone, and The New Level to shake up the roster. At the same time, debates have emerged over whether AEW should reduce current World Champion Will Ospreay's frequent in-ring schedule to prevent overexposure and protect his main event status.

stories.title: Tony Khan Addresses Speculation on Mara Sadè Joining AEW
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan addressed speculation regarding former WWE and TNA talent Mara Sadè during the All Out 2026 media call, describing her as a tremendous young prospect of great interest to the company. While Khan stopped short of confirming a signing or an upcoming appearance, Sadè recently fueled rumors with a cryptic social media post referencing Saturday. During the same call, Khan also shared touching details about late wrestler Andy The Butcher Williams, revealing that he had been meeting with officials about potential backstage roles and music collaborations before his passing.

stories.title: Tony Khan Details Past AEW Discussions With Andy 'The Butcher' Williams
stories.tldr: During the AEW All Out media call, Tony Khan shared details about recent backstage discussions he had with the late Andy The Butcher Williams regarding potential office roles and collaborative music events. Khan noted that Williams had pitched innovative ideas to bridge the gap between the wrestling and music communities before his passing. Additionally, Khan addressed growing speculation surrounding former WWE and TNA talent Mara Sade potentially making her promotional debut at the upcoming pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Jim Ross to Miss AEW All Out 2026, Provides Health Update
stories.tldr: Hall of fame commentator Jim Ross will not make his expected return to the AEW commentary booth at All Out 2026 in Chicago. During his podcast, co-host Conrad Thompson confirmed that Ross will watch the show from home as he continues recovering from August brain surgery and a recent fall that resulted in broken toes. Additionally, Ross recently underwent biopsies for concerning moles found by his dermatologist. He still praised the sold-out All Out event and the main event between Will Ospreay and Jon Moxley, eyeing AEW WrestleDream in October as a potential return date.

stories.title: Thekla Addresses Rumors Surrounding Kairi Sane and Mercedes Mone
stories.tldr: AEW star Thekla recently addressed various rumors surrounding her peers, including speculation about Kairi Sane potentially joining All Elite Wrestling and clarifying a recent promo from Mercedes Mone. Regarding Sane, Thekla expressed excitement about the possibility of new faces entering the promotion while maintaining a wait-and-see attitude. Separately, Thekla clarified that Mone's recent insulting remarks about a five-foot blonde were not actually directed at her, fueling fan speculation that the jab was instead aimed at WWE star Alexa Bliss. Meanwhile, Thekla is focused on her own championship aspirations as she prepares to face Willow Nightingale to determine the number one contender for Mone's AEW Women's World Championship.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett Predicts High Ceiling for Andrade El Idolo in AEW
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Jeff Jarrett recently expressed high praise for Andrade El Idolo on his My World podcast, highlighting the star's recent performances and organic momentum. Jarrett specifically told co-host Conrad Thompson that he believes Andrade has what it takes to eventually become the AEW World Champion if he stays the course. The discussion also previewed Andrade's upcoming AEW National Championship defense against PAC at the upcoming All Out pay-per-view event.

stories.title: Jon Moxley's Death Riders Booked for DEFY Wrestling Match
stories.tldr: Jon Moxley is bringing two of his Death Riders stablemates to DEFY Wrestling for a high-profile six-person match next month. They will face off against the trio known as The Infantry at the Lincoln Factory in Detroit on October 1. The match features a blend of men and women competitors from AEW colliding in an independent setting. Standing-room-only tickets were still available at the time of the announcement, though no championship or special stipulations have been confirmed yet.

stories.title: Katsuyori Shibata Scheduled for New Texas Pro Wrestling Show
stories.tldr: AEW star and New Japan legend Katsuyori Shibata is scheduled to make his promotional debut for New Texas Pro Wrestling. He will appear at the company's eighth-year anniversary event taking place in Houston, Texas. The landmark show is set for Friday, October 30, and will also feature stars like Bryan Keith, Kylie Rae, and The King Bees. Currently, Shibata is signed to AEW and Ring of Honor, where he performs as part of The Opps alongside Samoa Joe, HOOK, and Anthony Bowens.

stories.title: United Empire Expanding in AEW Under Will Ospreay
stories.tldr: Will Ospreay is actively expanding his incarnation of the United Empire in AEW, most recently adding Speedball Mike Bailey alongside Andrade and Francesco Akira. As the faction heats up its feud with the Death Riders and addresses internal friction with New Japan Pro-Wrestling's branch led by Callum Newman, speculation grows regarding potential new recruits like the Motor City Machine Guns, Wardlow, and Kip Sabian. This cross-promotional expansion sets the stage for major clashes both in AEW rings and across the Pacific.

stories.title: Tony Schiavone Compares Recent AEW Match to Flair vs. Steamboat
stories.tldr: AEW commentator Tony Schiavone recently compared Will Ospreay and Kenny Omega's match at AEW All In: London to the legendary 1989 rivalry between Ric Flair and Ricky Steamboat. Speaking on the Battleground Podcast, Schiavone drew parallels between the modern classic and the historic Flair-Steamboat trilogy. Omega and Ospreay currently hold a 2-2 record against each other across their four singles matches, while the Young Bucks also praised the bout as one of the best they have ever witnessed live.

stories.title: Who Should The Young Bucks Face in Their Final AEW Match?
stories.tldr: Recent comments from Karl Anderson indicate that The Young Bucks contracts with All Elite Wrestling are set to expire in 2027, sparking speculation about their potential retirement. With Matt and Nick Jackson nearing the end of their legendary careers, wrestling analysts have compiled a list of ideal dream opponents for their potential final match. Potential opponents range from longtime rivals and former mentors to legendary tag teams and former stablemates.

stories.title: Previewing Potential Title Changes at AEW All Out 2026
stories.tldr: All Elite Wrestling is preparing for AEW All Out 2026 in Chicago on September 26, where six championships will be defended and the landscape of the company could drastically change. This preview highlights three major potential title changes, including high-stakes bouts for the International, National, and World Tag Team Championships. Fans can expect monumental shifts as determined challengers look to capture gold under intense circumstances.

stories.title: Wheeler Yuta Discusses Death Riders Faction Dynamics in AEW
stories.tldr: Wheeler Yuta recently discussed Will Ospreay's brief stint with the Death Riders faction in All Elite Wrestling. Yuta explained that Ospreay initially fit in well during training and shared the group's work ethic, but the partnership ended when Ospreay refused to attack Kenny Omega. While Yuta acknowledges that Ospreay shares some values regarding hard work and pushing standards, he lacks the ruthlessness required for a permanent spot in the stable.

stories.title: Will Ospreay Teases Future Match With Ilja Dragunov
stories.tldr: AEW World Champion Will Ospreay recently expressed high praise for former WWE star Ilja Dragunov, highlighting his unique intensity and potential impact on the company. Following reports that Dragunov has signed with AEW after his WWE contract expired, Ospreay suggested that a future singles match between them could be a major money-drawing event. Ospreay noted that despite sharing common roots in wXw, they have never faced each other in the ring and believes Dragunov's unmatched energy would make him an immediate standout on the roster.

stories.title: AEW News Roundup: All Out Open Challenge, Grand Slam Paris, Dynamite/Collision Overrun
stories.tldr: TBS Champion Persephone has issued an open challenge for her title at the upcoming All Out pay-per-view, excluding Thunder Rosa, Maya World, and Hyan. In international news, Chris Jericho will face Nick Wayne at AEW Grand Slam Paris on October 6, and the company has announced another three-hour combined Dynamite and Collision broadcast for October 16. Additionally, upcoming television will feature a tag team match in Pittsburgh, while digital exclusives highlighted comments from the Young Bucks and Dezmond Xavier following recent shows.

stories.title: Thunder Rosa Reflects on AEW Women's Division Trajectory
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Thunder Rosa recently discussed her influential role in shaping the trajectory of All Elite Wrestling's women's division. Speaking with Zach Johnson, she highlighted her iconic Unsanctioned Lights Out match against Dr. Britt Baker DMD as a pivotal moment that redefined brutal women's wrestling. Rosa also noted the division's continued evolution through milestone events like the women's Blood and Guts match, while expressing gratitude for her diverse career achievements across the globe.

stories.title: Reaction and Ratings Success for Roman Reigns vs. Penta on WWE RAW
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns successfully defended the World Heavyweight Championship against Penta on the September 14, 2026 episode of WWE RAW in Mexico City, delivering the second-biggest worldwide viewership numbers for the show all year despite tough Monday Night Football competition. This massive success has shifted backstage creative plans, with WWE now heavily supporting a potential rematch and viewing Penta through a new, main-event-level lens. Following the bout, Penta secured a spot in the upcoming Men's Money in the Bank Ladder Match, further cementing his elevated status as WWE also utilizes the luchador push to boost broader brand awareness.

stories.title: WWE Main Event Moving to Rumble, Airing Opposite AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: WWE has announced a long-term distribution partnership with the video platform Rumble to make it the new exclusive streaming home for its weekly program, Main Event. Beginning October 14, 2026, new episodes will stream every Wednesday at 8 p.m. ET, placing the show directly head-to-head against AEW Dynamite on TBS. The show previously aired on YouTube after bouncing across various platforms like the WWE Network, Hulu, and Peacock since its debut in October 2012. Executives from both WWE and Rumble praised the deal as a major step toward expanding digital audiences and sports programming lineups, though specific financial terms were not disclosed.

stories.title: Apollo Crews Details TNA Slammiversary Appearance and WWE Release
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Apollo Crews recently discussed his post-WrestleMania release and how he made a surprise appearance at TNA Slammiversary under his old ring name, Uhaa Nation, while still bound by his 90-day non-compete clause. Crews revealed that TNA successfully worked with WWE to clear his appearance, though he initially pushed back against losing because of his lengthy losing streak in the company. During the same interview, he also opened up about predicting his release ahead of time, struggling with his post-WWE identity, and his initial strong hesitation toward his past Nigerian royalty gimmick.

stories.title: Penta Emerges as Internal Favorite to Win WWE Money in the Bank
stories.tldr: Penta has reportedly emerged as the internal heavy favorite to win the upcoming Men's Money in the Bank ladder match. This marks a significant creative shift for WWE, as a push of this magnitude was not planned as recently as SummerSlam. The change in direction stems from the overwhelmingly positive reaction and record-breaking viewership of his World Heavyweight Championship match against Roman Reigns in Mexico City. Alongside this momentum, Penta has seen a surge in merchandise sales, internal analytics, and search interest.

stories.title: WWE Waiting for Right Time for Seth Rollins' TV Return
stories.tldr: Seth Rollins has been absent from WWE television since his high-profile match against Roman Reigns at SummerSlam, though he recently returned to action on the company's live event tours. Backstage reports indicate that creative plans for his television comeback are fully lined up, but officials are currently waiting for the right moment to execute them. While Rollins was initially discussed for a spot at the upcoming Money in the Bank Premium Live Event, those plans have reportedly shifted. Additionally, uncertainties surround CM Punk's potential involvement in the same event.

stories.title: Triple H Gives High Praise and Advice to Dragon Lee Backstage
stories.tldr: Following his stellar Intercontinental Championship match against Chad Gable on the September 14 episode of WWE Raw in Mexico City, Dragon Lee received high praise and crucial safety advice from Paul Triple H Levesque backstage. Levesque specifically warned Lee to save dangerous high-risk spots, like a brutal table bump, for special occasions to protect his body from long-term damage. Amid reports that Dragon Lee's current WWE contract is set to expire fairly soon, Levesque emphasized that he views the talented star as a vital part of the company's long-term future.

stories.title: Roman Reigns Discusses WWE Retirement and Future In-Ring Plans
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns recently updated his WWE retirement timeline, noting that he actually has a few more years of storytelling loose ends and logical gaps to address before walking away for good. He emphasized his responsibility to use his equity to elevate rising talent and help launch the next generation of superstars. Additionally, the World Heavyweight Champion discussed his role as Akuma in the upcoming Street Fighter movie, drawing parallels between the gaming character and his own Tribal Chief persona.

stories.title: Uncertainty Surrounds WWE x AAA Worlds Collide Broadcast Plans
stories.tldr: Major confusion surrounds the upcoming WWE x AAA Worlds Collide event in Chicago regarding how fans can watch it. Despite featuring a loaded card with CM Punk and Rey Mysterio running opposite AEW All Out, WWE has failed to announce official broadcast or streaming details. Even AAA commentator JBL admitted he is unsure of the plans, revealing he will not be traveling to Chicago and that commentary may be recorded after the fact. Some analysts suggest the lack of broadcast plans might be an intentional strategy to boost live ticket sales rather than traditional viewing.

stories.title: Growing Concern Within WWE Over Crown Jewel Event in Saudi Arabia
stories.tldr: Growing concern is reportedly spreading within WWE and TKO regarding the upcoming Crown Jewel event scheduled for November 7 in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The anxiety stems from a recent U.S. State Department Level 3 travel advisory urging Americans to reconsider travel to the region due to risks of Iranian drone and missile attacks, armed conflict, and terrorism. Employees and frequent travelers have been internally asking if the show will be rescheduled or moved, though WWE has not yet formally addressed the situation with its staff. Despite the backstage worries and inquiries reaching Stamford headquarters, the event remains officially on the calendar as planned.

stories.title: Backstage Details on Botched Finish to Sami Zayn vs. Kevin Owens WWE Title Match
stories.tldr: The finish to the Undisputed WWE Championship match between Sami Zayn and Kevin Owens on SmackDown was severely botched due to an unplanned kickout. CM Punk interfered by hitting Owens with the title belt, but confusion ensued when Owens kicked out and the referee failed to ring the bell. The wrestlers had to improvise the remainder of the match before Zayn finally secured the win with a second Helluva Kick. Backstage officials were reportedly unhappy that the botch diminished the impact of Punk's involvement in the ongoing storyline.

stories.title: WWE Announces 10 New Dates for 2026 Holiday Tour
stories.tldr: WWE has officially announced ten new dates for its annual Holiday Tour taking place across the United States this December. The schedule features a mix of live house shows and a combined Raw and SmackDown taping in Tampa, Florida, on December 28. Notably, the company is returning to New York City's Madison Square Garden on December 26 following a schedule shift the previous year. Tickets for all newly added events will go on sale to the general public on October 2, preceded by an exclusive presale on October 1.

stories.title: Evaluating the WWE and TNA Wrestling Partnership
stories.tldr: The working relationship between WWE NXT and TNA Wrestling, which began in early 2015 and helped TNA secure a media rights deal with AMC Network, appears to be slowly declining as NXT crossovers decrease. Historically, WWE partnerships with companies like ECW, USWA, Evolve, and UK promotions often resulted in those allies suffering or shutting down while WWE absorbed their top talent. Meanwhile, TNA is navigating a busy 2016 roster landscape ahead of Bound for Glory, with potential new signees emerging from expiring AEW contracts such as Scorpio Sky, Max Caster, and Dralistico.

stories.title: Kurt Angle Postpones UK Tour Due to Health Issue
stories.tldr: WWE and TNA Hall of Famer Kurt Angle has postponed his upcoming appearance tour in the United Kingdom due to an undisclosed health issue. Angle was scheduled to appear for the National Wrestling League in Manchester and for Inside the Ropes live events in London and Glasgow. The Inside the Ropes dates have been rescheduled for early February 2027, with existing tickets remaining valid. Meanwhile, the National Wrestling League is providing automatic refunds for VIP meet-and-greets while determining further information for general admission holders.

stories.title: Netflix Pleased With RAW Mexico City Performance, Wants More Marquee Matches
stories.tldr: Netflix and WWE are reportedly thrilled with the massive success of the September 14 episode of RAW, which was broadcast live from Mexico City. Despite airing directly opposite the opening week of NFL Monday Night Football, the high-profile broadcast pulled in approximately three million global views. Following this strong performance, the streaming platform has expressed a clear desire for WWE to regularly feature more marquee matches and top-tier talent on the weekly show moving forward.

stories.title: WWE Reportedly Planning $45 Million Upgrade to TV Production Fleet
stories.tldr: WWE is reportedly planning a major infrastructure upgrade by replacing its aging fleet of television production trucks after more than a decade of use. The company will introduce three new mobile production units built by N.E.P. Integration in Pennsylvania to serve as the nerve center for live broadcasts. Each unit is estimated to cost between $12 million and $15 million, bringing the total projected investment to between $36 million and $45 million. A specific timeframe for when these new trucks will officially go into service has not yet been announced.

stories.title: Triple H Discusses Post-In-Ring Roles for Undertaker and Shawn Michaels
stories.tldr: WWE Chief Content Officer Paul Triple H Levesque recently opened up in a behind-the-scenes vlog about seeing his longtime friends and contemporaries, Shawn Michaels and The Undertaker, succeed in their post-in-ring executive roles. Levesque expressed deep emotion watching them pass their vast industry knowledge down to the next generation of talent. He specifically highlighted Michaels taking WWE NXT to new heights and The Undertaker revitalizing Lucha Libre as the head of creative for AAA following its acquisition by WWE.

stories.title: Rhea Ripley Provides Update on Knee Injury Recovery
stories.tldr: WWE Women's Champion Rhea Ripley has provided an update on her recovery from meniscus surgery, urging fans to remain patient after a TikTok video showed her walking well without a knee brace. Ripley clarified that walking and wrestling are entirely different, noting that she only recently learned how to walk again following her August surgery. Sidelined since June, Ripley currently shares the title picture with interim champion Chelsea Green, whom she is expected to face upon her return. Meanwhile, friends like IYO SKY view the unexpected time off as a much-needed break from Ripley's notoriously grueling work ethic.

stories.title: Chad Gable Discusses El Grande Americano Gimmick
stories.tldr: Chad Gable recently discussed the origins of the El Grande Americano gimmick during a podcast appearance, revealing he never intended the persona to be a comedy act. Instead, he designed the character to be a dead-serious tool to insult lucha libre culture and make his feuds deeply personal. The persona originated following his debut loss to Penta and subsequent quest to learn lucha libre, leading to a dual-character storyline. The saga eventually concluded at Noche de Los Grandes 2026, where Ludwig Kaiser, who had taken over the gimmick during Gable's injury, defeated Gable's Americano and unmasked him.

stories.title: Karl Anderson Received Death Threats Over Signing With WWE as NJPW Champion
stories.tldr: Karl Anderson recently revealed that signing with WWE in late 2022 while still holding the NEVER Openweight Championship in New Japan Pro Wrestling resulted in a severe backlash, including actual death threats from intense fans. The controversial move created a high-profile scheduling conflict on November 5, when Anderson was booked for WWE Crown Jewel in Saudi Arabia on the exact same day he was originally scheduled to defend his NJPW title against Hikuleo. Although he ultimately retained his championship before dropping it to Tama Tonga at Wrestle Kingdom 17 in January 2023, Anderson clearly hasn't forgotten the extreme hostility he faced during that strange period of his career.

stories.title: CM Punk's WWE Money in the Bank Status Uncertain
stories.tldr: There is currently uncertainty surrounding CM Punk and his potential participation at the upcoming WWE Money in the Bank premium live event. Although he is scheduled to compete against Finn Balor and Gunther for a qualifying spot in the ladder match, he does not have any other official matches locked in for the card. Sources indicate that while working the event was previously discussed by creative, it is no longer guaranteed at this time. Meanwhile, Punk remains officially confirmed to compete this weekend at the WWE x AAA Worlds Collide event in a six-man tag team match.

stories.title: Saquon Shugars Challenging Chad Gable at NXT House Show
stories.tldr: Saquon Shugars is stepping up to challenge Chad Gable for the WWE Intercontinental Championship at an upcoming NXT live event. It was previously advertised that both IYO SKY and Gable would work the NXT house shows in Columbia, South Carolina, and Greensboro, North Carolina. Shugars officially announced his title opportunity on social media ahead of the first night in South Carolina. Gable has held the championship since winning it at SummerSlam in August, successfully defending it twice against Rey Mysterio and Dragon Lee.

stories.title: Maven Recalls Angering Vince McMahon Over WrestleMania Mistake
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Maven recently reflected on his four-year tenure with the company, highlighting his famous Royal Rumble elimination of The Undertaker alongside a less fortunate botch at WrestleMania X8. During his match against Dustin Rhodes, Maven completely missed a signature dropkick involving a trash can, which immediately drew the wrath of Vince McMahon backstage. Stressed about his upcoming segment with Christian Cage, Maven managed to salvage the night and continued working for the company for another three years before his 2005 departure.

stories.title: Damian Priest Attacks R-Truth at WWE Performance Center
stories.tldr: The tension between Damian Priest and R-Truth spilled over away from television when Priest ambushed Truth at the WWE Performance Center. Truth had just expressed genuine emotional hurt over the betrayal, emphasizing that their bond extended far beyond the wrestling ring and included their families. Priest brutally attacked him from behind and declared their friendship dead, cementing his ongoing heel turn on SmackDown.

stories.title: Tiffany Stratton Opens Up About Training Mishap and Music Collaboration
stories.tldr: WWE star Tiffany Stratton recently discussed a scary training mishap during a livestream where she attempted to learn a new over-the-top-rope dive and struck her head on the apron, though she fortunately avoided serious injury and plans to try it again. She also touched upon her unexpected music collaboration with rapper Lil Yachty, who offered to help her write and record a rap song on the fly during a stream. Stratton praised Yachty for his genuine lifelong fandom of professional wrestling, noting that he watches all WWE programming and trains in the ring every single day.

stories.title: Analysing WWE's Perennial World Title Contenders
stories.tldr: LA Knight, Kevin Owens, and Finn Balor represent three of WWEs top perennial runner-ups who constantly fall short of securing a major world title. While Owens and Balor previously held the Universal Championship in 2016, both have repeatedly failed in subsequent high profile opportunities, alongside LA Knight who faces mounting pressure to capture his first world championship. An analysis of their current trajectories ranks Finn Balor as the least likely to win soon due to a brutal Money in the Bank qualifying match, LA Knight in the middle with his momentum threatened by long-term booking plans, and Kevin Owens as the most likely due to his proximity to the gold and a potential storyline with Sami Zayn.

stories.title: Braun Strowman and David Arquette Cast in Netflix Competition Show
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Braun Strowman and former WCW World Champion David Arquette have been announced as contestants for a new celebrity edition of Netflix's competition series, Celebrity Million Dollar Secret. The 13-person cast, revealed on September 23, will compete in a game where one secret participant holds a box containing one million dollars while the others try to uncover their identity. Hosted by Peter Serafinowicz, the show is scheduled to premiere on Netflix sometime in 2027.

stories.title: Retrospective on WWE's Most Emotional Moments
stories.tldr: This retrospective explores some of the most emotionally resonant and heartbreaking moments in WWE history, moving beyond pure shock value to examine genuine sadness. It highlights three specific instances, including Paul Heyman pleading for rescue during the Bloodline saga, Bayley facing a painful betrayal by Damage CTRL, and Shawn Michaels delivering his iconic farewell to Ric Flair at WrestleMania 24. Ultimately, the piece reflects on how different wrestling moments trigger personal emotional reactions for fans around the world.

stories.title: F4W Daily Update Overview
stories.tldr: The latest professional wrestling news roundup covers major industry developments, including WWE planning for Crown Jewel and recent storylines involving Damian Priest and R-Truth. The report also highlights extensive coverage of the historic Mexico City wrestling weekend featuring CMLL, WWE, and AAA, alongside various audio and video retrospectives. Additionally, updates are provided on AEW preparations, injury reports, historical wrestling milestones, and media rights deals across the sport.

stories.title: WWE News Briefs: Natalya Dental Injury, CM Punk Lucha Mask, MSG Updates
stories.tldr: Natalya recently revealed she required 20 stitches and dental implants after a brutal match at AAA TripleMania, though she has already been medically cleared to return to action. In other news, WWE is capitalizing on CM Punk nostalgia by releasing new Straight Edge Society merchandise ahead of Worlds Collide in Chicago, while also offering ticket discounts for upcoming events like Money in the Bank. Additionally, MSG advertising points to a Raw-branded holiday show in December, and recent media coverage highlighted the controversial move of WWE Main Event to the Rumble platform.

stories.title: CM Punk Throws First Pitch at Chicago Cubs Game
stories.tldr: WWE star and Chicago native CM Punk returned to Wrigley Field to throw out the ceremonial first pitch before the Chicago Cubs game against the Miami Marlins. Wearing a jersey to support breakout star Pete Crow-Armstrong, Punk also led the crowd in singing Take Me Out To The Ball Game. Unfortunately, his appearance did not bring the Cubs luck as they fell 3-2 to the Marlins. Outside of baseball, the Straight Edge Superstar remains heavily focused on the ring as he prepares for upcoming SmackDown qualifying matches for the Men's Money in the Bank Ladder Match.

stories.title: Court Grants WWE Request to Pause Discovery in ESPN Lawsuit
stories.tldr: A U.S. District Court has granted WWE a procedural victory by pausing discovery in an ongoing class-action lawsuit filed by fans. The lawsuit alleges that WWE, ESPN, and BAMTech misled consumers regarding how to watch major events following the 2025 move to ESPN Unlimited. ESPN, BAMTech, and WWE successfully argued that the case should be paused while the court considers moving the dispute to individual arbitration based on subscriber terms of service. Although the plaintiffs raised concerns about WWE's past evidence spoliation in a separate stockholders case, the judge ruled that forcing broad discovery prematurely would be disproportionate.

stories.title: Matt Cardona Provides Update on WWE Injury Recovery
stories.tldr: Injured WWE star Matt Cardona has provided an update on his tricep injury recovery, revealing he aims to return ahead of schedule at the Royal Rumble in February 2027. Cardona tore his tricep during a match on WWE Main Event in August, leading to immediate surgery just as he was gaining momentum on SmackDown through a feud with GUNTHER. Despite the setback, the former Intercontinental Champion joked that his injury was simply the result of being too muscular.

stories.title: MVP Praises Zilla Fatu's Potential in WWE
stories.tldr: AEW star MVP recently discussed the immense potential of Zilla Fatu on his podcast, weighing the advantages and pressures of coming from the legendary Anoa'i wrestling family. While noting that the Fatu name provides a significant head start and bankable status, MVP emphasized that Zilla also faces heavy expectations to match his late father Umaga's legacy. Ultimately, MVP believes that with his size, charisma, and talent, Zilla can become a major WWE star if he continues to put in the hard work required at the NXT level.

stories.title: Roman Reigns Praises Longtime WWE Rival Cody Rhodes
stories.tldr: Roman Reigns recently offered high praise for his longtime rival Cody Rhodes during a media interview. Reflecting on the intense demands of carrying the billion-dollar WWE machine, Reigns acknowledged that Rhodes has successfully proven his worth as a leader and the face of the company. The Original Tribal Chief also discussed the grueling nature of the position and noted that legends like John Cena and himself took a decade to reach that status, unlike the anomalous rapid rise of Dwayne The Rock Johnson.

stories.title: Discussion on CM Punk's Future in WWE
stories.tldr: This excerpt from NoDQ and AV Live invites wrestling fans to participate in a live discussion regarding the future of CM Punk in WWE, specifically posing the question of whether it is time for him to retire. Viewers are encouraged to engage through the live chat, send Superchats to prioritize their questions, and support the channel by liking, subscribing, and purchasing merchandise. The broadcast is hosted by Aaron Rift, who encourages fans to share their thoughts and follow the coverage on social media.

stories.title: Drake Maverick Clarifies Current WWE Status
stories.tldr: Former 24/7 Champion Drake Maverick has clarified that he remains with WWE as a backstage writer and producer rather than an active in-ring competitor. Questions about his status arose after he recently returned to the ring for British promotion Progress Wrestling for a brief weekend stint. While his recent matches have sparked speculation about a potential wrestling comeback for WWE or TNA Wrestling, Maverick is currently focused entirely on his duties behind the camera.

stories.title: WON Flashback: Retrospective on WWE No Mercy 2017 Shield Matches
stories.tldr: This retrospective looks back at WWE No Mercy 2017, held on September 24, which featured two critically acclaimed 4-star-plus matches involving members of The Shield. Dave Meltzer of the Wrestling Observer Newsletter awarded 4.25 stars to both the Raw Tag Team Championship match where Dean Ambrose and Seth Rollins defended their titles against Sheamus and Cesaro, and the high-profile singles clash between John Cena and Roman Reigns. The event highlighted major moments, including Cesaro suffering a brutal dental injury against the ring post and Reigns defeating Cena in a match that served as a symbolic passing of the torch.

stories.title: Former Wyatt Sicks Members Joseph Sawyer & Samuel Shaw Debut in TNA as Syx
stories.tldr: Former WWE stars Joseph Sawyer and Samuel Shaw, known as Joe Gacy and Dexter Lumis in the Wyatt Sicks faction, made their surprise debut on TNA Impact by attacking Matt and Jeff Hardy. Revealing themselves after weeks of backstage assaults, the duo debuted under the team name Syx. TNA quickly confirmed that both men have officially signed with the promotion.

stories.title: TNA Impact Recaps, Notes, and Match Lineups
stories.tldr: The latest episode of TNA Impact from San Antonio brought high-stakes action on the road to Bound for Glory, featuring major match announcements, championship qualifiers, and faction shifts. Mustafa Ali returned from injury to successfully defend his International Championship while dealing with the fracturing of his Order 4 group. Meanwhile, authority drama led to suspensions, setting up explosive grudge matches and tournament qualifiers for the upcoming pay-per-view.

stories.title: Juggalo Championship Wrestling News: Russo Exit, Creative Changes & Roster Updates
stories.tldr: Vince Russo has departed Juggalo Championship Wrestling after selling his fifty percent ownership stake to Violent J, who is now returning to lead the promotion's creative direction for the landmark one hundredth episode of Lunacy. While veteran Big Vito confirmed he is staying with the company despite his long-time friend Russo leaving, the roster experienced major on-screen shakeups. These events included Kerry Morton being controversially fired after allegedly missing a title challenge time limit by a single second, and Dijak brutally attacking Mr. Happy with a baby stroller amid an ongoing storyline involving Jasmin St. Claire.

stories.title: TNA Brings Back Call Your Shot Gauntlet for Bound for Glory
stories.tldr: TNA has officially announced the return of the Call Your Shot Gauntlet match for the upcoming Bound for Glory pay-per-view on October 11, 2026. The winner of the multi-person bout will receive a trophy and earn the right to challenge for any TNA championship at any time of their choosing. Bear Bronson, Avery Styles, and Frankie Kazarian have already been confirmed as early participants in the high-stakes match. Meanwhile, other roster members like AJ Francis are actively campaigning for a spot as the rest of the card takes shape.

stories.title: Elayna Black Earns TNA Knockouts TV Title Match
stories.tldr: Elayna Black has secured a match for the TNA Knockouts Television Championship by winning a fast-paced Fatal Four-Way match on TNA Impact. She defeated Gabby Forza, Harley Hudson, and Jada Stone, capitalizing on the chaos in the closing moments to hit her signature finisher for the victory. Black will now challenge the reigning champion, M By Elegance, though the official date and location have not yet been announced. Under the championship rules, the upcoming title bout will take place on Impact programming and feature a strict 10-minute time limit.

stories.title: The Hardys Call Out Attackers, TNA Sets Matches for Impact and Bound for Glory
stories.tldr: The Hardys have officially called out their mystery backstage attackers, who revealed themselves as Joseph Sawyer and Samuel Shaw under the group name Syx, setting up a war for the upcoming TNA iMPACT episode. Meanwhile, the road to Bound for Glory heats up as Ryan Nemeth secured his spot in the six-way X Division Championship scramble. Additionally, TNA authority figure Santino Marella laid down a strict zero tolerance rule prohibiting World Champion Nic Nemeth and challenger Leon Slater from physical contact before their main event clash under threat of being stripped of the title or losing the shot.

stories.title: MLW Fightland Match Announcements: Killer Kross, Místico, Lady Frost, Templario
stories.tldr: Major League Wrestling is gearing up for its Fightland broadcast from Charleston, South Carolina, featuring a stacked card airing free on Tubi with replays on YouTube, VEEPS, and NJPW World. The event is highlighted by a volatile tag team match where champion Killer Kross and rival Josh Bishop must coexist against Místico and Austin Aries. Additionally, Lady Frost has issued an open challenge to stake her claim in the women championship picture, while CMLL stars Black Tiger and Templario clash in singles action.

stories.title: STARDOM News: Rina Yamashita Tags, Ruaka Attacks Hanan
stories.tldr: Rina Yamashita secured a victory for Mi Vida Loca during STARDOM's September 23 show in Shimonoseki and hinted at entering the upcoming Goddess of Stardom Tag League. At the same event, Ruaka brutally attacked Wonder of Stardom Champion Hanan and stole her championship belt just days before their scheduled title match at Korakuen Hall.
