The action-packed Silver Week tour stop also featured tag team action and dominant performances from H.A.T.E. in front of 509 fans.

stories.title: Pro Wrestling History: Historical Matches and Title Changes for September 24
stories.tldr: September 24 holds a rich history in professional wrestling, featuring numerous legendary matches and significant championship changes across various promotions. Industry evaluations highlight exceptional bouts like Will Ospreay versus Yota Tsuji as modern classics. Additionally, historical records show nearly 300 notable title changes on this specific date over the decades. These range from classic WWF championship victories to major international title shifts in NJPW, CMLL, and DDT.

stories.title: AZM and Miyu Amasaki Heading to CMLL Grand Prix
stories.tldr: STARDOM tag team champions AZM and Miyu Amasaki, known as the 02line partners and reigning Goddesses of Stardom Champions, are heading to Mexico to compete at CMLLs Grand Prix de Amazonas 2026. The announcement was made on CMLLs official Informa program, confirming their appearance at the historic Arena México on October 23. While their exact opponents and match formats have not yet been revealed, this trip provides a major cross-promotional opportunity following their recent domestic defenses and matches in Japan.

stories.title: Former Queen's Quest Members Match Set for STARDOM Osaka Show
stories.tldr: Four former members of the Queen's Quest faction are set to collide in a tag team match at STARDOM’s September 26 Silver Week Tour stop in Osaka. AZM and Utami Hayashishita will join forces to face off against Hina and Lady C at ATC Hall. This booking highlights ongoing tensions and nostalgia surrounding the faction's history, which recently flared up during a September 12 championship match involving the old group flag. Additional marquee matches on the Osaka card include Miyu Amasaki taking on Saya Kamitani in singles competition.

stories.title: Místico and El Desperado Retain IWGP Junior Tag Titles in Sapporo
stories.tldr: Mistico and El Desperado successfully defended their IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Championship against DOUKI and SHO in Sapporo. The heated match followed a bitter dispute over stolen masks and featured heavy interference from House of Torture. Despite numerous outside shenanigans and near falls, the champions ultimately secured the victory by locking in simultaneous submissions. This decisive defense solidifies the cross promotional pairing of CMLL and NJPW talent as dominant titleholders.

stories.title: Mustafa Ali Retains International Championship on TNA Impact
stories.tldr: Mustafa Ali successfully defended his TNA International Championship in a chaotic triple threat main event against former champions Jason Hotch and Trey Miguel on TNA Impact. Despite dealing with pre-match locker room departures in Order 4 and relentless double-teaming, Ali managed to survive a barrage of high-impact moves. He ultimately capitalized on outside interference to use his championship belt on Miguel, securing the victory in his first title defense since Lockdown.

stories.title: Kevin Knight Set to Host Seminars at NJPW Academy
stories.tldr: Current AEW star and two-time IWGP Junior Heavyweight Tag Team Champion Kevin Knight is scheduled to host special training seminars at the NJPW Academy in October. Open to wrestlers aged 18 and older with previous experience, the sessions will take place at the NJPW LA Dojo in Carson, California. Participants can choose between two different training blocks, with discounted rates offered to current academy students. Additionally, Knight is slated for a major match at the 2026 AEW All Out pay-per-view alongside Kyle Fletcher against Steven Borden and Darby Allin with tag team title opportunities on the line.

stories.title: Indi Hartwell Challenging Xia Brookside at TNA Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: Indi Hartwell successfully manipulated her way into a championship opportunity by intentionally provoking authority figure Daria Rae on the September 24th episode of TNA Wrestling Thursday Night iMPACT. After Rae slapped her on camera—while Director of Authority Santino Marella secretly recorded the altercation—Marella suspended Rae and granted Hartwell a Knockouts World Championship match against Xia Brookside. This high-stakes title match is now officially locked in for TNA Bound For Glory on October 11th, joining an increasingly stacked pay-per-view lineup.

stories.title: Rosemary Return Teased With Vignette on TNA iMPACT
stories.tldr: TNA Wrestling recently aired a creepy new vignette on iMPACT teasing the imminent return of Rosemary, who has been absent from television since August. The surreal segment featured a calm version of Rosemary speaking to another version of herself trapped in a straitjacket, hinting at a darker and more complex character evolution. Her return creates an intriguing dynamic within the Knockouts division, as Kiera Hogan has since stepped in to fill Rosemary's spot and currently holds the Knockouts World Tag Team Championships alongside Allie. While an official return date has not yet been announced, the compelling promo leaves fans wondering whether the returning star will target her former championship or seek answers upon her comeback.

stories.title: Masha Slamovich Makes MLW Debut Following TNA Departure
stories.tldr: Masha Slamovich has made her Major League Wrestling debut at Fightland, immediately aligning with CONTRA and defeating Lady Frost in an open challenge. This high-profile return marks her first major promotion appearance since her departure from TNA late last year following domestic violence accusations made by her former partner, AKIRA. Despite TNA removing her from their roster and editing her out of previously taped programming, Slamovich is wasting no time establishing herself in her new home.

stories.title: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling Adds Six-Man Tag to Northern Rising Event
stories.tldr: Maple Leaf Pro Wrestling has added a major six-man tag team match to their upcoming Northern Rising event on October 3. The bout was announced during the September 23 episode of Mayhem after Johnny TV, TJP, and Gabriel Fuerza secured a victory. They will now face the cross-promotional team of Mark Andrews, Flash Morgan Webster, and Mascara Dorada in Toronto. The sold-out card at the historic Mattamy Athletic Centre also features marquee matches including Josh Alexander versus Stu Grayson and Adam Copeland versus Steve Maclin.

stories.title: AJ Francis Announces Canned Food Drive at Maryland Homecoming
stories.tldr: TNA wrestler and former University of Maryland football player AJ Francis has announced his 10th annual canned food drive, scheduled for the Maryland football homecoming on October 17, 2026. The charity effort benefits Sarah’s House, an Anne Arundel County program providing housing, meals, and support services to people in need. Fans unable to attend the game in person can utilize a direct online donation link provided by Francis. While continuing his active career in TNA Wrestling—including aspirations for another Call Your Shot Gauntlet appearance at Bound For Glory—Francis maintains this longstanding community project independently.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth Heading on Tampa Media Tour Ahead of Bound For Glory
stories.tldr: TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth is heading to Tampa, Florida, for a two-day media tour on September 30 and October 1 to promote the upcoming Bound For Glory pay-per-view. During his visit, he will conduct various interviews to preview the October 11 event taking place at the Yuengling Center. At the show, Nemeth is scheduled to defend his world title against Leon Slater, who earned the match by invoking Option C and relinquishing the X-Division Championship. Furthermore, Nemeth enters the event holding dual championships, as he is also one-half of the TNA World Tag Team Champions with his brother Ryan Nemeth, though no tag title defense has been announced yet.

stories.title: RevPro Books Conor Mills vs. Katsuhiko Nakajima for London Show
stories.tldr: Revolution Pro Wrestling has officially scheduled a major singles match between Conor Mills and Katsuhiko Nakajima for its October 4 event at Porchester Hall in London. Whether the Undisputed British Heavyweight Championship will be on the line depends entirely on the outcome of Mills upcoming title defense against Kuro in Paris. Nakajima brings an impressive resume of holding major titles in Japan, making this encounter a severe test for Mills regardless of the championship stakes. Fans can secure tickets and streaming details through the promotion's official event and on-demand pages, with doors opening at 3:45 p.m. and a 4:30 p.m. bell time.

stories.title: NJPW Sets Next IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship Defense
stories.tldr: YOH will defend his IWGP Junior Heavyweight Championship against Robbie X at Korakuen Hall on Wednesday, October 7, as part of NJPW's Road to King of Pro Wrestling tour. YOH earned the title in June by defeating DOUKI after winning the Best of the Super Juniors tournament, and he has since successfully defended the gold against Francesco Akira and Taiji Ishimori. Robbie X stepped up as the next challenger following YOH's recent defense against Ishimori, setting the stage for the upcoming title showdown live on NJPW World.

stories.title: Gable Steveson Criticized Following UFC Knockout Loss
stories.tldr: Former Olympic wrestling champion and WWE performer Gable Steveson suffered a devastating 12-second knockout loss against heavy underdog Sean Sharaf at UFC 331. Following the quick defeat, former PFL and Bellator champion Usman Nurmagomedov criticized Steveson's transition to mixed martial arts. Nurmagomedov argued that despite Steveson's elite wrestling credentials, he lacks the necessary striking skills and amateur MMA experience to succeed at the highest level of the sport.

stories.title: Contract status updates on The Young Bucks, Kenny Omega, and The Acclaimed
stories.tldr: The AEW contract statuses of several prominent names have drawn attention amid reports that Kenny Omega and the Young Bucks are nearing the end of their current deals, with Karl Anderson indicating they will wind down soon. Meanwhile, former tag team champions Anthony Bowens and Max Caster of The Acclaimed are just days away from their contracts expiring at the start of October. With no active negotiations or extension offers reported for Bowens and Caster, Bowens has also definitively ruled out any future reunion for the duo.

stories.title: Persephone announces and defends TBS Title Open Challenge at AEW All Out
stories.tldr: AEW TBS Champion Persephone successfully defended her title against Hyan using the ropes for leverage on the September 23 episode of Dynamite. Following the match, Persephone issued an open challenge for her championship at the upcoming All Out pay-per-view in Chicago. However, she explicitly barred Maya World, Thunder Rosa, and Hyan from answering the call, setting up a tag team match for the following week instead.

stories.title: Swerve Strickland & New Level to defend AEW Trios Titles at All Out
stories.tldr: On the September 23 episode of AEW Dynamite, Swerve Strickland and The New Level successfully defended the AEW World Trios Championships against The Demand in a hard-fought opening bout. This victory officially locked in their upcoming title defense against Hangman Adam Page, Brody King, and Bandido at the All Out pay-per-view in Chicago. Following the match, the challengers confronted the champions, leading to a tense war of words between Strickland and Page regarding their past actions and trust in their partners. The high-stakes showdown adds to a heavily anticipated card for this Saturday event.

stories.title: Tony Khan comments on Warner Bros. Discovery and Paramount merger impact on AEW
stories.tldr: AEW President Tony Khan recently took to social media to express strong optimism regarding the impending merger between Warner Bros Discovery and Paramount. Speaking ahead of a live episode of AEW Dynamite where top WBD officials were in attendance, Khan stated that the corporate union will ultimately make AEW a stronger company. He also heavily praised incoming leader David Ellison, highlighting his background in sports, television, and his purported fandom of professional wrestling. The merger itself recently cleared a major legal hurdle after Paramount reached a settlement with California and eleven other states, though court approval is still pending.

stories.title: Chris Jericho vs. Nick Wayne set for AEW Grand Slam France
stories.tldr: Chris Jericho and Nick Wayne are officially scheduled for a high-stakes rematch at AEW Grand Slam France, taking place on Tuesday, October 6, at the Adidas Arena in Paris. The match stems from their recent encounter on Dynamite where Jericho won, prompting a retaliatory post-match attack from Wayne involving a low blow and a rope kick. During a subsequent confrontation on Collision, Jericho compared Wayne to his arrogant younger self and referenced advice from the late Nick Bockwinkel, before accepting Wayne's challenge for the international showdown.

stories.title: AEW Dynamite and Collision September 23 show coverage, ticket sales, and match updates
stories.tldr: AEW hosted a super-sized, three-hour combined Dynamite and Collision special at the Fishers Event Center in Indiana as the final stop before the All Out pay-per-view. The stacked card featured multiple title matches and last-minute additions, drawing 2,683 distributed tickets which fell slightly short of the company year-to-date average. Reviewers and fans shared mixed reactions regarding the storytelling and pacing of the divisions while looking forward to the weekend card.

stories.title: Will Ospreay recruits 'Speedball' Mike Bailey into United Empire on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: On the go-home edition of AEW Dynamite before All Out, AEW World Champion Will Ospreay officially recruited Speedball Mike Bailey into the United Empire faction. Bailey initially showed hesitation due to his past alliance issues with Kevin Knight, but ultimately accepted the invitation. Following his recruitment, Bailey teamed up with Ospreay in the main event to successfully defeat the Death Riders duo of Claudio Castagnoli and Gabe Kidd. The dramatic episode also set the stage for Ospreay's upcoming World Championship defense against Jon Moxley at the upcoming pay-per-view.

stories.title: Jake Hager undergoes emergency eye surgery following Power Slap bout
stories.tldr: Former WWE and AEW star Jake Hager underwent emergency eye surgery following a brutal TKO loss to Johnny Magna in Power Slap. The severe injury resulted in blood and fluid leaking from his eye, prompting Dana White to label it one of the worst he has ever witnessed in combat sports. White provided an update that Hager is being sent to a Miami specialist for further evaluation, while emphasizing the promotion's focus on fighter safety and medical care. Amidst the medical scare, Hager also shared positive personal news by announcing his engagement to fellow Power Slap competitor Patricia Blackburn.

stories.title: Thunder Rosa discusses her AEW TV usage and character presentation
stories.tldr: Former AEW Women's World Champion Thunder Rosa recently opened up about her current television usage, admitting she has not been featured on AEW programming as much as she would like. To stay active and sharp, the Mexican National Women's Champion has been keeping busy working with other promotions like CMLL and focusing on her craft outside the ring. Meanwhile, Rosa also reflected on what makes AEW unique, praising the edginess of its characters and high level of wrestling compared to other places. She looked back fondly on her career milestones, including her historic Lights Out match and championship victory, while noting how much the women's division has grown over the years.

stories.title: Bryan Keith hopes to bring back original entrance theme in AEW/ROH
stories.tldr: AEW and ROH star Bryan Keith is actively pushing to bring his signature independent wrestling entrance theme, Mike Jones and the track Still Tippin, back to his televised appearances. Keith originally secured the track through his connection to the Houston-based Swishahouse music label and used it during his early matches with the company. Although the song was eventually replaced, Keith revealed during a recent podcast appearance that he is trying hard to get it reinstated. Meanwhile, the Texas native has been absent from television recently, with his last ROH match in August and his last AEW bout against Kazuchika Okada in May 2026.

stories.title: Match card and preview for AEW All Out 2026
stories.tldr: AEW All Out 2026 takes place this Saturday from the Now Arena in Chicago, featuring an eight-match main card stacked with championships and high-stakes opportunities. Will Ospreay defends the AEW World Championship against Jon Moxley in the headliner, while legendary veterans collide in a chaotic three-way ladder match for the tag team titles. The card also features notable bouts like Steven Borden's pay-per-view debut alongside Darby Allin, and a women's contendership rematch between Willow Nightingale and Thekla.

stories.title: AEW's MJF featured in first trailer for movie 'Stranglehold'
stories.tldr: AEW star MJF makes his latest acting appearance in the first red band trailer for the upcoming crime comedy and darkly comedic thriller Stranglehold, directed by Clark Duke. Scheduled for a digital and VOD release on October 2, the film boasts a star-studded cast including Ashley Benson, Ron Perlman, Justin Long, and Jake Lacy. Wrestling fans will also spot familiar faces like former WWE broadcast team member Kayla Becker, formerly known as Kayla Braxton, and former WCW World Champion David Arquette. This role adds to MJF's growing Hollywood resume, which already includes appearances in Happy Gilmore 2 and the upcoming Violent Night 2 as he balances his full-time wrestling career with acting.

stories.title: Juice Robinson explains shaving signature beard due to gym accident
stories.tldr: AEW star Juice Robinson recently revealed that a freak gym accident was the real reason behind shaving off his signature long beard prior to his return last year. While recovering from a broken fibula, Robinson got his facial hair caught in a lat pulldown cable, which painfully ripped out several hairs mid-set. Angered and embarrassed by the mishap, he went home and completely shaved his face to create a shocking blank slate for his comeback. This prompted a temporary new look featuring all-black gear before he eventually grew his facial hair back to a shorter length.

stories.title: Thekla explains setting boundaries with fans at airports
stories.tldr: AEW star Thekla recently discussed her strict boundaries regarding fan interactions, admitting she can be very harsh when stopped by people while rushing through airports. However, she noted that she is completely happy to chat with fans once she is settled and waiting at her boarding gate. During the same interview, she also shared an emotional and memorable first meeting with WWE Hall of Famer Mick Foley, who praised her for bringing something genuinely new to the wrestling industry.

stories.title: Persephone & Britt Baker vs. Thunder Rosa & Hyan announced for AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: AEW has announced a high-profile women's tag team match for the final Dynamite episode of September. Britt Baker and Persephone will team up to take on Thunder Rosa and Hyan. Hyan selected Rosa as her new partner following Maya World's current absence. This upcoming bout marks Baker and Persephone's first standard tag team match together since they aligned at AEW All In.

stories.title: AEW WrestleDream 2026 ticket sales update
stories.tldr: AEW WrestleDream 2026 has distributed 4,035 tickets for its upcoming October 17 event at the Addition Financial Arena in Orlando, which is currently configured for 4,940 fans. While this trails last year's St. Louis event by over 2,200 tickets, the promotion still has several weeks to boost sales before the pay-per-view. With no matches officially announced yet as creative focus remains on the upcoming All Out event, AEW has time to close the gap and sell out the remaining 905 seats.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes makes surprise appearance segment on AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Cody Rhodes made a surprise return to AEW Dynamite four years after leaving the promotion, though not in a wrestling capacity. Instead, the former AEW executive vice president appeared on screen during a commercial break dressed as Guile to promote the upcoming live-action Street Fighter movie. The cameo caught fans off guard given his high-profile departure in February 2022 and subsequent run in WWE. The film, hitting theaters on October 16, also features other wrestling stars like Roman Reigns and Hirooki Goto alongside actor Jason Momoa.

stories.title: AEW tag team division stars brawl in TLC promo segment
stories.tldr: During the September 23 episode of Dynamite, AEW World Tag Team Champions Adam Copeland and Christian Cage traded verbal jabs with challengers the Young Bucks and FTR to hype their upcoming three-way TLC match at All Out. The intense confrontation quickly devolved into a massive brawl as all three veteran teams unloaded on security guards. The chaotic segment featured high-flying ladder action, table breaks, and a trademark brutal conchairto.

stories.title: The Blade signs multi-fight contract with PRODUCE Wrestling
stories.tldr: The Blade has signed a multi-fight agreement with PRODUCE Wrestling for upcoming shows in Brooklyn and Los Angeles following the passing of his longtime tag team partner, Andy Williams, who wrestled as The Butcher. The promotion announced the deal on September 15, framing it as a violent tribute to Williams, who tragically died following a medical emergency during an independent match earlier this month. For his first match under the new contract, The Blade is scheduled to face Hot Sauce Tracy Williams in a singles bout at the Brooklyn event on October 12. He is also advertised for the Los Angeles show on October 22, though his opponent for that date has not yet been named.

stories.title: Jim Ross reflects on working with the late Bill Dundee
stories.tldr: AEW commentator Jim Ross recently used his Grilling JR podcast to honor the late Memphis wrestling icon Bill Dundee, who passed away earlier this month at age 82. Ross reflected on their time working together in Mid-South Wrestling during the mid-1980s, praising Dundee's unmatched wrestling mind and creative genius despite lacking a formal education. The veteran announcers also discussed why Dundee never competed as an in-ring talent in WWE due to Vince McMahon's preference for taller wrestlers during the Golden Era, noting that Dundee later missed an opportunity to join the creative team following backstage friction with The Undertaker.

stories.title: Speculation on retirement match scenarios for Chris Jericho and Kenny Omega
stories.tldr: AEW top stars Chris Jericho and Kenny Omega are eventually facing in-ring retirement, prompting speculation on how their legendary careers might conclude. While Jericho has previously indicated retirement is not in his near future, Kenny Omega admitted last year that he has been thinking a lot about hanging up his boots. Analysts suggest Jericho's final feud should elevate MJF, while Omega's swan song belongs against his longtime rival Will Ospreay. Both veterans will likely receive a celebrated retirement tour similar to past legends rather than a sudden, unannounced departure.

stories.title: Potential AEW wrestler hosts discussed for MyAEW programming
stories.tldr: The streaming platform MyAEW is expanding its content offerings to include original programming and podcasts to rival audio networks like WWE Radio. Industry observers have suggested several talent pairings ideal for hosting duties, including absent stars Kip Sabian and Penelope Ford, top champion Mercedes Mone, and seasoned broadcasters Taz, Tony Schiavone, and Nigel McGuinness. While WWE Radio leans heavily into audio formats, MyAEW focuses primarily on video while retaining strong podcast integration to engage subscribers.

stories.title: Kevin Knight discusses influences of Swerve Strickland and Lio Rush
stories.tldr: Rising professional wrestler Kevin Knight recently discussed his inspirations in the industry, highlighting Swerve Strickland and Lio Rush for paving the way with authentic representation. Knight explained that he wanted to break traditional molds and be taken seriously as a Black man in wrestling, much like his idols did on the independent scene. He also shared his excitement about eventually sharing the ring with both men in major matches. Additionally, Knight playfully called out Will Ospreay and Gabe Kidd for their questionable music taste regarding UK grime rap.

stories.title: Zayda Steel recalls experience in WWE ID program
stories.tldr: AEW rising star Zayda Steel recently reflected on her time as the very first prospect announced for the WWE ID program in 2024 before she ultimately signed with AEW. During a virtual signing with Captains Corner, she described herself and others in the initiative as guinea pigs and test dummies while explaining that the weekly stipend provided crucial financial relief for independent wrestlers. Steel credited the program with helping her finally quit her two outside jobs and focus entirely on her professional wrestling career, defending the project against outside criticism.

stories.title: Kofi and Austin Creed offered outside non-wrestling roles
stories.tldr: Following their surprising departure from WWE, former New Day members Kofi Kingston and Austin Creed quickly found themselves flooded with outside opportunities rather than facing unemployment. Speaking on Renee Paquette's Close Up show, the current AEW World Trios Champions revealed that their strong presence in the gaming and anime communities kept their schedules full during their non-compete period. Both wrestlers emphasized the importance of developing interests outside of the ring and spending quality time with their families.

stories.title: Jeff Jarrett reflects on recent career milestone venues
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Jeff Jarrett recently reflected on his illustrious career and highlighted two major bucket-list experiences from his time with AEW and CMLL. He specifically pointed to wrestling in the Casino Gauntlet match at Wembley Stadium as a dream come true due to the incredible venue and fan response. Additionally, Jarrett celebrated his involvement in the CMLL anniversary show at Arena Mexico, noting the profound historical connection given his familys eighty years in the professional wrestling industry.

stories.title: Jim Ross praises Death Riders member as future main eventer
stories.tldr: AEW commentator and WWE Hall of Famer Jim Ross recently discussed The Death Riders on his Grilling JR podcast, expressing high praise for PAC. Ross stated that PAC is a consummate professional and easily has the talent to become a main event-level star in the company. This comes as PAC prepares to face Andrade El Idolo for the AEW National Title at the All Out 2026 pay-per-view event. Meanwhile, his stablemate Jon Moxley is set to challenge AEW World Champion Will Ospreay.

stories.title: Nyla Rose reveals scrapped AEW street fight against Vickie Guerrero
stories.tldr: Former AEW women's division standout Nyla Rose recently revealed that she and her former manager, Vickie Guerrero, were originally slated to culminate their alliance with a violent street fight. Rose envisioned expanding their pairing into a larger faction that would ultimately lead to them colliding in the ring. However, creative plans were ultimately scrapped by the promotion due to the extreme nature of the angles Rose proposed, including an idea to have Guerrero run her over with a car. Despite the cancellation and the disruptions of the era, Rose looks back fondly on the creative freedom and memorable skits they shared during their time together.

stories.title: Roman Reigns comments on Cody Rhodes carrying WWE, stepping back, and roster depth
stories.tldr: In a recent interview, Roman Reigns discussed the immense pressures of leading WWE and praised Cody Rhodes as the only current star besides himself who has proven capable of carrying the company's banner. Reigns also addressed his own future, explaining that while he is eventually phasing out and looking to help elevate younger talent, he still plans to stick around for a few more years to explore long-term storylines. Meanwhile, analysts are examining the current roster depth, wild card challengers like LA Knight, and potential next-generation main eventers as WWE navigates its evolving landscape.

stories.title: Kam Hendrix reacts to viral video of Maxxine Dupri and Austin Theory
stories.tldr: WWE NXT wrestler Kam Hendrix has responded to fans bombarding his social media after a cozy video of his real-life wife Maxxine Dupri and her on-screen partner Austin Theory went viral. The clip shows Theory carrying Dupri on his shoulders while they lip-sync as part of their Monday Night Raw storyline with the Vision faction. Rather than showing jealousy, Hendrix posted an Instagram video from his vacation explaining that he is completely unbothered while watching alligators. He instead used the attention to warn the wrestling roster that everyone is mid and will get cooked when he returns to the ring.

stories.title: Chelsea Green discusses Matt Cardona, Tiffany Stratton, and personal stories
stories.tldr: Chelsea Green recently discussed various topics during an interview with Chris D'Comedy, including her marriage to Matt Cardona and a surprising childhood story about being arrested in English class. Green and Cardona revealed that they never fight over money, career opportunities, or attention, though they have established boundaries regarding on-screen romance. Additionally, Green shared a wild personal story about leaving a threatening Post-it note that resulted in her getting arrested during high school and receiving a peace bond.

stories.title: CM Punk teases classic theme song and nostalgic return for WWE Worlds Collide
stories.tldr: CM Punk is teasing a nostalgic throwback to his Straight Edge Society era ahead of the upcoming WWE and AAA Worlds Collide event in Chicago. Using social media, Punk shared a promotional graphic featuring his 2010 mask and quoted lyrics from his former entrance theme, This Fire Burns by Killswitch Engage. He is scheduled to team with Rey Mysterio and El Grande Americano to face Omos, Dominik Mysterio, and JD McDonagh at the Allstate Arena. Meanwhile, WWE has yet to officially announce broadcast details for the show, which takes place on the same night as AEW All Out in the Chicago area.

stories.title: Copyright lawsuit against WWE over Bloodline storyline dismissed
stories.tldr: A federal judge has officially dismissed a copyright lawsuit filed against WWE and 2K by independent promoter Nathaniel Tatha-Nanandji. The WCWA Wrestling promoter had accused WWE of stealing The Bloodlines famous one finger in the air gesture from his Tier 1 faction. The court ruled that the plaintiff failed to prove WWE had access to the material or that the two sequences shared substantial legal similarity. Because the dismissal is with prejudice, the plaintiff cannot refile the claim, completely ending the legal battle.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa addresses his use of artificial intelligence
stories.tldr: WWE star Tommaso Ciampa recently revealed that he has become a massive fan of artificial intelligence in his personal life after being introduced to it six months ago. He praised the technology for its ability to remember past conversations and assist with everyday tasks like parenting and health inquiries. Ciampa jokingly remarked that the AI knows him better than his wife while also humorously acknowledging fears that it might eventually turn on his family. His comments arrive as generative AI remains a controversial topic in the professional wrestling industry regarding promotional materials and creative storylines.

stories.title: Chad Gable discusses career advice and vision for WWE Intercontinental Title reign
stories.tldr: WWE Intercontinental Champion Chad Gable discussed the vision behind his current title reign, aiming to create high-stakes, longer matches where fans genuinely believe the belt could change hands on any given night. He highlighted recent defenses against stars like Dragon Lee as examples of building legitimate threats and high crowd investment. In the same interview, Gable reflected on veteran career advice, revealing it took him nearly a decade to fully implement Randy Orton lessons on in-ring efficiency. He also credited The Undertaker with helping him unlock the raw intensity and competitive nature from his amateur wrestling background.

stories.title: Trick Williams vs. opponent in Steel Cage US Title match set for WWE SmackDown
stories.tldr: SmackDown General Manager Nick Aldis has announced a high-stakes Steel Cage match for this Friday night in Indianapolis, where Trick Williams will defend the United States Championship against Baron Corbin. The stipulation was made to contain their spiraling rivalry, which recently saw Corbin lay out Williams and Lil Yachty. In addition to this title defense, Williams has already punched his ticket to the Men's Money in the Bank Ladder Match. The stacked September 25 episode will also feature high-profile MITB qualifiers including CM Punk versus Gunther versus Finn Balor, and Charlotte Flair taking on Giulia and Lash Legend.

stories.title: Analysis of Mason Rook's push and dream match against Gunther in NXT
stories.tldr: NXT standout Mason Rook is currently preparing for a high-stakes NXT Championship match against Grayson Waller, following his victory in a number one contender match involving Tony D'Angelo and Saquon Shugars. Backed by high-profile support from John Cena and a strong initial push since arriving in WWE, Rook represents the final major newcomer from his signing class to challenge for the brand's top title. Meanwhile, Waller looks to establish his newly won championship reign, creating intense speculation over whether the title will change hands on the upcoming episode of NXT. In addition to his current championship pursuit, Rook recently expressed his admiration for Gunther on Busted Open Radio, naming an earlier, heavier version of the star known as WALTER as his ultimate dream opponent and a major influence on his own wrestling style.

stories.title: WWE NXT kicks off 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic tournament
stories.tldr: The 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic has officially kicked off on WWE NXT with the first round of matches featuring a diverse talent pool from NXT, the main roster, AAA, and EVOLVE. Alongside the tournament action, the latest episode addressed an injury to Dorian Van Dux and set up a stacked card for next week featuring multiple championship matches and the return of Myles Borne. Meanwhile, wrestling observers are already speculating about a potential women's version of the Dusty Classic given the thriving women's division.

stories.title: Kurt Angle ranks Chris Benoit as his greatest career rival
stories.tldr: During an appearance on the Stiff Shot Podcast, WWE Hall of Famer Kurt Angle participated in a blind ranking of ten of his greatest career rivals. His final list placed Chris Benoit at the very top, followed closely by wrestling legends like Shawn Michaels and Eddie Guerrero. After seeing the completed list, Angle admitted he would remove Jeff Jarrett because their feud was based more on personal storylines involving his ex-wife than actual in-ring performance. He stated he would replace Jarrett with Nigel McGuinness, citing their strong matches together in TNA.

stories.title: Braun Strowman cast in NBCUniversal/Netflix reality series
stories.tldr: Former WWE star Braun Strowman, billed under his real name Adam Scherr, has been cast in the upcoming third season of Netflix reality competition series Million Dollar Secret. The show marks its first ever celebrity edition featuring a 12-person cast that also includes former WCW World Champion David Arquette. Scheduled to premiere in 2027 and hosted by Peter Serafinowicz, the series places contestants in a mansion where they must determine which person is secretly holding a box containing one million dollars. Since his departure from WWE, Scherr has focused heavily on television ventures, including his USA Network food series Everything on the Menu.

stories.title: Drake Maverick confirms continued role as WWE writer and producer
stories.tldr: Drake Maverick has confirmed that he remains actively employed by WWE as a backstage writer and producer, putting to rest any speculation regarding his status following a recent, rare in-ring return in the United Kingdom under his former name, Rockstar Spud. Addressing fans on social media, Maverick clarified that his contributions to the company now happen strictly behind the camera. Additionally, the veteran performer recently opened up about his positive working relationship with WWE creative head Triple H, praising him for always being approachable and receptive to creative pitches.

stories.title: Lexis King reflects on his experience in the WWE NXT system
stories.tldr: Lexis King recently discussed how transitioning into the WWE and NXT system caused him to second-guess his abilities despite his prior experience and wrestling heritage. Speaking on Busted Open, the second-generation star explained that the promotion intentionally breaks down talent to put everyone on an even playing field rather than relying on their previous notoriety. He also pointed out that fellow second-generation wrestler Zilla Fatu will likely experience this same rigorous mental conditioning upon entering the system. King currently performs as part of the BirthRight faction alongside other legacy wrestlers in NXT.

stories.title: Vanta The Unknown makes in-ring debut on WWE Evolve
stories.tldr: Vanta The Unknown has made her official in-ring debut on WWE Evolve by defeating Veronica Haven, standing out with a true gimmick name in an era dominated by overly conventional or awkwardly spelled real-sounding names. Formerly known as Jessica Bogdanov, a gymnast and pole dancer from Russia signed after the SummerSlam 2025 tryouts, her viral packaging and unique presentation signal a potential major push in the NXT women's division. However, the show itself faces unique hurdles as a heavily pre-taped developmental brand where airing talent often no longer works for the company.

stories.title: WWE SmackDown viewership ratings for September 18, 2026
stories.tldr: WWE SmackDown on September 18, 2026, brought in 1,264,000 viewers on the USA Network alongside a 0.29 rating in the key 18 to 49 demographic. This marked a slight week-over-week increase of 44,000 viewers compared to the September 11 episode, while the key demo rating remained steady at 0.29. However, when compared to the same week in 2025, viewership experienced a year-over-year decline of 2.6 percent and a 19.4 percent drop in the demo. These metrics strictly represent linear television broadcasts on the USA Network and exclude digital or streaming consumption.

stories.title: WWE previews potential surprises for Money in the Bank 2026
stories.tldr: WWE is gearing up for the Money In The Bank 2026 premium live event in New Orleans, Louisiana, featuring high-stakes ladder matches and championship bouts. Speculation is high regarding potential historic moments, including Je’Von Evans potentially becoming the youngest MITB winner in history. Additionally, Roxanne Perez could shake up The Judgment Day by winning the women's briefcase and cashing in on Liv Morgan, while LA Knight challenges Roman Reigns for the World Heavyweight Championship.

stories.title: Rhea Ripley provides update on recovery from injury
stories.tldr: Rhea Ripley recently tempered fan expectations regarding her in-ring return after a TikTok video showed her walking without a knee brace in Tampa, Florida. While the footage sparked rumors of an imminent WWE comeback following her meniscus surgery, Ripley clarified that she only just learned how to walk unaided last week. She urged the WWE Universe to stay patient, emphasizing that everyday movement is vastly different from the physical demands of professional wrestling.

stories.title: Mick Foley explains leaving WWE Legends contract
stories.tldr: Mick Foley has confirmed that he feels no regret over ending his WWE Legends contract, despite taking a noticeable pay cut as a result of his decision. Speaking on a recent podcast, the hardcore icon clarified that the agreement only covered occasional appearances and signing trading cards, noting that he has not been a full-time WWE employee in nine years. Foley walked away from the lucrative deal due to his discomfort with WWE being too close to the current U.S. president and specific political remarks he could not abide by, though he still deeply values his historical time with the promotion. The financial impact of the departure became starkly apparent to him at WrestleCon in Las Vegas, where he had to work twenty hours to match what a four-hour WWE commitment would have paid him, but he remains entirely at peace with the choice.

stories.title: Reunited Lucha Brothers aimed at revitalizing WWE tag team division
stories.tldr: The WWE tag team division has experienced a significant decline over the past year, with most of the teams from last year's SummerSlam ladder match having disbanded. While acts like Fraxiom remain bright spots, the division desperately lacks depth and excitement. The eventual full-time reunion of the Lucha Brothers, Penta and Rey Fenix, could provide the major spark needed to revitalize the entire tag team scene.

stories.title: Danhausen teases potential Fortnite crossover
stories.tldr: WWE star Danhausen has sparked speculation about a potential collaboration with Fortnite after reacting to a teaser for the upcoming Fortnitemares 2026 event. Fortnite promoted its annual Halloween update with the tagline The Game Is Cursed, prompting Danhausen to reply with a close-up photo of his face paint. While neither WWE nor Epic Games has officially confirmed a crossover, such an appearance would align with Danhausen's growing merchandise footprint and WWE's established history of putting wrestlers in the game.

stories.title: Bully Ray criticizes LA Knight's promo on WWE Raw
stories.tldr: LA Knight recently cut a promo on WWE Raw to build his upcoming championship match against Roman Reigns. During the segment, Knight showed unusual self doubt and acknowledged past hesitance about whether anyone could defeat the Tribal Chief. Wrestling veteran Bully Ray criticized this approach, arguing that Knight should project unwavering confidence instead of showing vulnerability. Ray believes Knight should have backed up his recent physical attacks with strong, definitive verbal warnings rather than relying on jokes or hesitation.

stories.title: Debate over whether WWE Crown Jewel should be postponed
stories.tldr: This editorial examines the ethical dilemma of WWE continuing its lucrative partnership with Saudi Arabia through events like Crown Jewel amidst escalating geopolitical conflicts in the Middle East, specifically following Houthi attacks on Riyadh. The piece critiques TKO's profit-driven corporate mentality, comparing the ruthless nature of modern capitalism to the willingness of entertainment companies and talent to overlook human rights abuses and regional violence for financial gain. Ultimately, it questions where the line should be drawn when corporate revenue pursuit intersects with global instability and the safety of performers and fans.

stories.title: Roxanne Perez positioning for WWE Women's Championship contention
stories.tldr: Roxanne Perez recently qualified for the women Money in the Bank match by defeating IYO SKY and La Catalina on WWE Raw, positioning herself for a potential championship opportunity. Despite her recent singles match losses throughout 2026 and limited tag team success, Perez has a chance to secure the briefcase on October 10. To establish herself as a credible top contender, she needs to transition away from losses and secure clean singles victories over her upcoming ladder match opponents.

stories.title: Drew McIntyre WWE TV return plans and storyline options
stories.tldr: Following a five-month absence from WWE television while filming multiple movies, Drew McIntyre is back in the United States and rumored to make his return on Raw or SmackDown soon. Creative options for the Scottish Warrior include targeting the United States Championship to officially achieve Grand Slam status, reigniting his violent Bloodline rivalry heading into Survivor Series WarGames, or immediately re-entering the Undisputed WWE Championship picture. With several high-profile avenues available, WWE has multiple compelling ways to reintroduce the former champion to the active roster.

stories.title: Penta reflects on facing Roman Reigns on WWE Raw
stories.tldr: WWE star Penta recently reflected on facing World Heavyweight Champion Roman Reigns in the main event of Monday Night Raw in Mexico City, calling it one of the biggest nights of his life and praising Reigns as the best wrestler in the world. Building on that momentum, Penta recently qualified for the upcoming Money in the Bank ladder match by defeating Dragon Lee and Dominik Mysterio on Raw. With his sights now set on the World Heavyweight Championship, Penta aims to secure a rematch against Reigns as he prepares for the high-stakes ladder match.

stories.title: Dominik Mysterio's status evaluated between AAA and WWE
stories.tldr: Dominik Mysterio has experienced a major downward spiral in both AAA and WWE, losing his AAA Mega Championship to El Grande Americano and suffering numerous singles losses in WWE over the summer. Despite no longer holding titles or prominent tournament spots, Mysterio could pivot toward a full time WWE tag team run with JD McDonagh or pursue AAA mixed tag gold alongside Liv Morgan. Ultimately, Mysterio does not need to choose between the two promotions, having previously proven he can successfully juggle a simultaneous presence on both sides of the border.

stories.title: Ewing Athletics releasing 'Macho Man' Randy Savage sneakers
stories.tldr: Ewing Athletics has announced a new footwear collaboration honoring WWE Hall of Famer Macho Man Randy Savage as part of their Legends Of The Ring collection. The Macho Man Randy Savage x Ewing FOCUS Cream of the Crop sneakers draw inspiration from Savage's legendary 1987 promo and his signature colorful bandana. Set to release on September 25, 2026, the shoes feature unique details including removable Velcro sunglasses and the champion's nickname on the heels.

stories.title: Bully Ray doubts Randy Orton winning another WWE World Title soon
stories.tldr: Randy Orton recently revitalized talks of capturing his 15th world championship after delivering a heated promo on SmackDown expressing his desire to add one more title to his illustrious career. However, his recent failure to qualify for the Money in the Bank ladder match has cast doubt on whether he will reach that milestone anytime soon. According to wrestling veteran Bully Ray, fans should temper their expectations regarding an immediate title reign for The Viper. Bully Ray believes that while Orton will likely get a championship opportunity, Cody Rhodes will ultimately cost him the match, potentially setting up a high-stakes showdown at WrestleMania next year.

stories.title: Report on original monster push plans for Gable Steveson in WWE
stories.tldr: WWE initially planned a massive Brock Lesnar-style monster push for Olympic gold medalist Gable Steveson after he signed in 2021, expecting him to reach a prominent WrestleMania spot quickly. However, creative plans were scrapped because officials felt he lacked sufficient in-ring development, promo skills, charisma, and overall effort compared to peers like Bron Breakker and his brother Bobby Steveson. Rising financial costs tied to his main-roster level contract while stuck in developmental ultimately led to his release in May 2024. Steveson has since transitioned to mixed martial arts, recently suffering a 12-second knockout loss to Sean Sharaf.

stories.title: Bryan Alvarez WWE NXT September 22 show report
stories.tldr: Subscribers can now access the latest analysis covering the September 22 episode of WWE NXT. Wrestling analyst Bryan Alvarez has released his detailed breakdown of the show for members. The report provides insights into the matches and segments that took place during the weekly broadcast. Fans of the developmental brand can check the subscription platform to read the full evaluation.

stories.title: Lexis King offers Avery Styles a spot in NXT faction BirthRight
stories.tldr: Lexis King recently expressed strong support for TNA Wrestling's Avery Styles to potentially join his NXT faction, BirthRight. Speaking on a recent podcast appearance alongside his stablemates, King praised Avery's in-ring talent, backstage professionalism, and the discipline he learned from his father, A.J. Styles. King also dismissed negative rumors about Avery's attitude and suggested that joining a group like BirthRight would help the young second-generation star carve out an independent identity.

stories.title: Kevin Nash vetoed Scott Hall hologram idea for WWE Hall of Fame
stories.tldr: Kevin Nash revealed on his podcast that he vetoed a proposal to use a hologram of his late friend Scott Hall during a WWE Hall of Fame presentation. Nash explained that members of Hall group needed to agree before money was spent, and he ultimately served as the deciding vote against the technology. His refusal was rooted in consent concerns, as he felt deceased performers cannot approve how their image is used and that Hall would not have wanted it.

stories.title: MVP credits Freddie Prinze Jr. for changing view on promo writers in WWE
stories.tldr: MVP recently shared how actor and writer Freddie Prinze Jr. completely shifted his traditional skepticism regarding outsiders contributing to WWE promos. While preparing a backstage go-home promo for a SummerSlam match against Jeff Hardy, MVP and a WWE writer struggled to find a strong closing line until Prinze provided the missing finish. The resulting segment received high praise from Vince McMahon and fellow wrestlers like Big Show, earning Prinze's respect from the veteran performer. Consequently, MVP now believes that qualified writers and actors without an in-ring background can still offer valuable guidance on constructing effective promos.

stories.title: Maria Kanellis reveals pay cut offer before 2010 WWE release
stories.tldr: Maria Kanellis recently opened up about the circumstances surrounding her 2010 departure from WWE. She revealed that management offered her a significant pay cut despite her heavy travel schedule, mainstream visibility, and high website engagement. After rejecting the proposal and submitting a counteroffer, she was released from the company by phone. Kanellis ultimately felt a sense of relief for standing her ground, noting that her popularity and web traffic rivaled top stars like John Cena at the time.

stories.title: Tommaso Ciampa wants to revisit silent entrance concept in WWE
stories.tldr: Tommaso Ciampa recently discussed his iconic silent entrance from his NXT days during an appearance on the Battleground Podcast. He reflected on the high-stakes gamble of walking out to no music in front of a hostile crowd at TakeOver: New Orleans during WrestleMania weekend. While he initially did not know if the bold creative choice would work, the overwhelmingly negative fan reaction cemented it as an unforgettable moment. Now, Ciampa envisions reversing that dynamic in the future by executing the exact same silent entrance as a beloved babyface to see how the crowd responds.

stories.title: NXT wrestler Dorian Van Dux sidelined with punctured lung
stories.tldr: NXT wrestler Dorian Van Dux is currently sidelined from in-ring action after suffering a punctured lung. He attempted to push through the injury for a scheduled six-man tag team match on the September 22 edition of NXT, but teammate Sean Legacy intervened to protect his health. EK Prosper stepped in as his replacement alongside Zilla Fatu and Legacy. There is currently no official timeline for his return as he awaits further medical evaluation and clearance from the WWE medical team.

stories.title: WON Flashback: Kurt Angle wins WWF Championship at Unforgiven 2001
stories.tldr: On September 23, 2001, the World Wrestling Federation held Unforgiven, marking their first pay-per-view event since the tragic events of September 11. In an emotional and critically acclaimed main event, Kurt Angle defeated Steve Austin to capture the WWF Championship in front of his real-life family at ringside. Dave Meltzer awarded the 23-minute match four stars in the Wrestling Observer Newsletter, highlighting its stiff style, high drama, and the feel-good celebration that closed the show.

stories.title: TNA interviewer Gia Miller to miss iMPACT tapings due to medical issue
stories.tldr: TNA interviewer and personality Gia Miller has announced she will miss this week television tapings in San Antonio, Texas, due to a sudden medical issue preventing her from travel. The upcoming schedule features a live episode followed by multiple nights of tapings building toward Bound For Glory. Miller released a statement apologizing to fans hoping to meet her at the events and assuring them she expects to recover soon. Specific details regarding her medical condition or a definitive timetable for her return were not disclosed.

stories.title: JCW announces 'Carnival of Chaos' for 100th episode following Vince Russo departure
stories.tldr: Juggalo Championship Wrestling is moving into a post-Vince Russo era following the amicable departure of the veteran booker, who admitted he had been unhappy for a while due to personal changes and roster challenges. To kick off this new chapter, the promotion has loaded up the card for the landmark 100th episode of Lunacy, titled Carnival of Chaos. The live and free YouTube special airing this Thursday features four championship matches, a GCW showdown, and several other high-profile bouts. Co-founder Violent J expressed deep gratitude for Russo's year-long tenure while promising an unforgettable night of mayhem for the fans.

stories.title: Matt Hardy proposes ideas for former Wyatt Sicks members in TNA
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestler Matt Hardy recently discussed rumors that former WWE Wyatt Sicks members Joseph Sawyer and Sam Shaw might be heading to TNA. Speaking on his podcast, Hardy suggested they adopt a hybrid gimmick blending their real identities with toned-down elements of their supernatural Wyatt Sicks personas. This speculation coincides with a series of mysterious backstage attacks on TNA talent, including both Matt and Jeff Hardy. Fans are now wondering if the former WWE stars are secretly behind these unsolved assaults.

stories.title: Former NXT wrestler Von Wagner (Cal Bloom) debuting in AJPW
stories.tldr: Former WWE NXT star Von Wagner, performing under his real name Cal Bloom, is heading to Japan to make his debut for All Japan Pro Wrestling. He will join the stable HAVOC alongside fellow former NXT talents Oddyssey and Xyon, as announced through a promotional video. Bloom is scheduled to wrestle his first match on October 22 at Korakuen Hall during the Founding Anniversary Series 2026, competing in an eight-man tag team match.

stories.title: CMLL announces full card for Noche de Campeones
stories.tldr: CMLL has officially revealed the complete fight card for its upcoming Noche de Campeones event scheduled for Friday, September 25. The entire show will consist of high-stakes championship matches across multiple divisions. Fans can look forward to a stacked lineup featuring top stars defending their titles in various singles and tag team bouts.

stories.title: TNA iMPACT viewership ratings for September 17, 2026
stories.tldr: TNA iMPACT experienced a decrease in total viewership for its September 17, 2026 episode on AMC, drawing 207,000 viewers compared to the previous week's 232,000. Despite the drop in overall audience, the show saw a slight increase in the key P18-49 demographic, rising from a 0.03 to a 0.04 rating. These figures strictly account for linear television broadcasts on AMC and exclude any digital or streaming metrics. Pro wrestling veteran Steve Carrier notes that coverage will continue as the promotion builds toward its upcoming major live event.

stories.title: Independent wrestler Leah Sparks suffers broken neck
stories.tldr: Independent wrestler and circus artist Leah Sparks, also known as LeeAnn Ball, suffered a severe broken neck during her most recent match. She fractured both sides of her C2 vertebra and dislocated the right side, requiring immediate surgery and a week-long hospital stay. Sparks is now recovering at home but faces an extended absence from both of her performing careers as she navigates an uncertain future. To help cover the costs of specialized care and ease financial pressure during her rehabilitation, she has launched a public fundraiser.

stories.title: After Dark Radio covers historical topics
stories.tldr: The latest episode of the late-night radio program features a discussion on horrifying historical topics with special guest Brenda Ganske. Listeners are treated to deep dives into subjects like Jack the Ripper, the use of real bones and dead bodies in films, and the psychological Third Man Factor. Additionally, the broadcast announces the official launch of a brand new companion website detailing new subscriber perks. It proves to be another entertaining and informative installment for the audience.

stories.title: Editorial on the cultural significance of lucha libre masks in Mexico
stories.tldr: This editorial explores the deep cultural, historical, and artistic significance of lucha libre masks in Mexico, tracing their origins back to 1934. The piece examines how the masks function not just as athletic gear, but as sacred pieces of identity rooted in pre-Columbian mythology and folklore. It also highlights their role in maintaining strict kayfabe traditions and driving high-stakes storytelling through dramatic wager matches inside the ring.

stories.title: F4W Daily Update covering news across WWE, AEW, and international promotions
stories.tldr: The latest wrestling news update covers Tony Khan discussing media mergers, Roman Reigns praising Cody Rhodes and explaining modern locker room dynamics, and various injury and contract updates across promotions. The recent newsletter features extensive coverage of the historic Mexico City wrestling weekend with CMLL, WWE, and AAA, alongside an in-depth obituary for Andy Williams. Additional notes highlight upcoming cards, historical retrospectives, television ratings on Netflix, and various talent updates involving Braun Strowman, MJF, and CM Punk.

stories.title: CJ Perry expands 'Bulletproof Angel' book and media projects
stories.tldr: Former WWE Superstar CJ Perry is teaming up with bestselling author Blake Northcott for a new spy thriller novel titled Bulletproof Angel. The project is already aiming for Hollywood through a book-to-film initiative with Paradigm before the book even hits shelves. To kick off the release, Perry and Northcott are embarking on a fan signing tour in Los Angeles with stops at Barnes and Noble and Golden Apple Comics. Fans can currently pre-order the novel across multiple major retailers including Amazon, Target, and Simon and Schuster.

stories.title: Wrestling Observer Live discusses NXT, Jake Hager, and AEW Dynamite
stories.tldr: Wrestling Observer Live returns with hosts Bryan Alvarez and Filthy Tom Lawlor breaking down the latest news and television in professional wrestling. The episode covers a packed night of content including a preview of AEW Dynamite and a review of NXT, which they deemed a great show with only two exceptions. Additionally, the hosts discuss Jake Hager's injury, the career history of Catalina, and a unique topic involving Vince Russo and an ex-juggalo.

stories.title: Xia Brookside reveals WWE rejected entrance theme she now uses in TNA
stories.tldr: Xia Brookside revealed that the entrance theme she currently uses in TNA, Where I Belong by Simple Plan featuring State Champs, was originally intended for her run in WWE NXT UK. After building a personal relationship with members of the band during their UK tour, Brookside secured the rights to the track with their help. However, WWE ultimately rejected the song, prompting her to successfully bring the track over to TNA after signing with the promotion.

stories.title: Nic Nemeth praises Leon Slater as future of professional wrestling
stories.tldr: TNA World Champion Nic Nemeth recently offered high praise for rising star Leon Slater, predicting that the young athlete will be running professional wrestling for the next twenty years. Nemeth highlighted Slater's impressive athleticism, high ring IQ, and humble backstage demeanor during an interview with Adrian Hernandez. The two are scheduled to face each other at Bound for Glory after Slater exercised Option C by vacating the X-Division Championship to challenge for the TNA World Title. While Nemeth acknowledges Slater as a future world champion, he intends to use his own experience and ring intelligence to defeat him.

stories.title: EMERGE Wrestling social media storyline escalates
stories.tldr: EMERGE Wrestling is taking its social media storytelling to wild new heights as the promotion approaches its milestone 100th event. A recent storyline development featured a GTA VI-style carjacking and kidnapping video, which faction member Paragon bizarrely dismissed as artificial intelligence. Meanwhile, stablemate Con The Conman Howse is preparing a hip-hop diss track in response to Commissioner Lowe and the promotion. These social media antics are heightening tensions for the upcoming Money Power Respect tag-team ladder match at EMERGE 100 on October 3.

stories.title: Ash By Elegance addresses health issues keeping her off TNA TV
stories.tldr: TNA star Ash By Elegance has addressed her ongoing absence from the ring, revealing she has been dealing with scary physical health issues for nearly a year. Although television storylines have framed her time away as a mental health break, Ash explained that she is prioritizing her well-being after pushing her body to return too quickly from previous ailments. While she remains sidelined without a specific return timetable or diagnosed condition disclosed, the former champion expressed a strong hunger to eventually make another in-ring comeback.

stories.title: Leyton Buzzard torn ACL injury update
stories.tldr: RevPro Undisputed British Cruiserweight Champion Leyton Buzzard revealed that he completely tore his left ACL during a title match at Wembley on August 29. Despite suffering the injury in the opening minutes, he managed to continue wrestling on one leg before undergoing a successful replacement surgery, which he announced on September 21. Having already sustained major injuries to both knees before turning 30, Buzzard has openly questioned his wrestling future. Consequently, the immediate status of his championship remains uncertain as the promotion moves forward with booking a new title match for its upcoming Paris weekend with APC.

stories.title: Eric Bischoff plans expansion for Real American Freestyle live events

Fans tuning into the broadcast will see a major card highlighted by an AEW World Trios Championship match featuring Swerve Strickland, Kofi, and Austin Creed defending against The Demand's Ricochet, Toa Liona, and Bishop Kaun, with the winners moving on to face Hangman and Brodido at AEW All Out.

stories.title: Top 10 pro wrestling matches on this day in history: September 22
stories.tldr: This historical retrospective highlights the top ten professional wrestling matches that took place on September 22, utilizing Cagematch ratings and prominent star ratings to rank them. Topping the list is the legendary 2021 non-title dream match between Bryan Danielson and Kenny Omega in All Elite Wrestling, which received a five-star rating. The list also features incredible bouts from promotions worldwide, including Dragongate, WWE, Big Japan, CHIKARA, Stardom, AAA, New Japan, Tokyo Joshi Pro, and SEAdLINNNG. Dave Meltzer's detailed analysis of the Danielson versus Omega encounter provides a deep dive into the pacing, storytelling, and high-impact moves that made it an instant classic.

stories.title: Jacari Ball Mocks Daejon Love Comparisons in “WWE Sent Me to Therapy” Video
stories.tldr: WWE ID talent Jacari Ball has released a new comedy video titled WWE sent me to therapy to lean even further into fan comparisons between his WWE Swindler character and Daejon Love. Playing both the therapist and himself in the sketch, Ball humorously defends his scammer persona, claims he was just getting reps with 17 recruits, and insists he is the solution rather than the problem. Despite previous playful protests that Love actually stole his method, Ball is now fully capitalizing on the viral joke to build his character.

stories.title: NXT’s Kendal Grey Shares Fears for Her Wrestling Future Amid Vertigo Struggle
stories.tldr: NXT star Kendal Grey opened up during an emotional therapy segment on the September 22 episode about her uncertain wrestling future while sidelined indefinitely with severe ear trauma and vertigo. The injury originally stemmed from an NXT Underground Match against Lola Vice and worsened while defending the NXT Women’s Championship against Kelani Jordan at Heatwave 2026, leading to a vestibular system injury and the loss of her title. Grey expressed deep emotional distress over not having a recovery timeline and fear that she might not return to the ring with the same physical abilities that defined her career.

stories.title: WWE NXT Championship match set for next week’s show
stories.tldr: Next week's episode of WWE NXT will feature two major championship matches, including Mason Rook challenging Grayson Waller for the NXT Championship after a heated war of words. In addition, NXT Women's North American Champion Zaria will defend her title against Thea Hail following a controversial backstage segment involving embarrassing school play footage. The broadcast will also showcase the return of Myles Borne after his vicious attack on Tavion Heights, alongside two opening round matches in the Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic tournament.

stories.title: Influencer Says She Will Not Reveal Mystery WWE Wrestler Behind Raya Referral
stories.tldr: Influencer Meredith Harris generated massive online curiosity after revealing that a former hookup currently working as a WWE wrestler used her as a referral to get onto the exclusive dating app Raya. Despite intense internet sleuthing and wild guesses from fans, Harris has firmly stated she has no intention of revealing the wrestler's identity. She recently took to Instagram to tell new followers that she does not care about wrestling and is keeping the secret to herself.

stories.title: Vince Russo announces departure from Juggalo Championship Wrestling
stories.tldr: Vince Russo has officially announced his departure from Juggalo Championship Wrestling after spending a year as an investor and creative showrunner for their weekly Lunacy program. Russo revealed on social media that he had been unhappy with the promotion for a while and needed time to evaluate his future before making a decision. Following an amicable phone conversation with Insane Clown Posse member Violent J, the two sides agreed to part ways. Russo expressed gratitude for his time with the company, praising the locker room, crew, and Violent J himself while noting that at age 65, his life and priorities have changed.

stories.title: Heated Confrontation Sets Up Mason Rook vs. Grayson Waller NXT Title Match
stories.tldr: During the September 22 episode of WWE NXT, champion Grayson Waller and challenger Mason Rook engaged in a deeply personal war of words ahead of their September 29 NXT Championship match. Waller mocked Rook with body-shaming jokes and insults about his work ethic and relationship with John Cena, while questioning his commitment. Rook fired back by referencing Waller's struggles on the main roster and failure to fit in with The Vision, vowing to choke out the champion. The fiery confrontation concluded with a tense face-to-face standoff to close the broadcast.

stories.title: Tommy Dreamer Says Solo Sikoa’s 946 Abduction Could Drive Him Back to His Family
stories.tldr: Wrestling veteran Tommy Dreamer believes that the recent abduction of Solo Sikoa by the group 946 on Monday Night Raw could force him to seek help from the family members he previously alienated. During an appearance on Busted Open, Dreamer analyzed how the angle removes Solo from his Money in the Bank qualifier and sets the stage for a broader fall storyline. He noted that this crisis gives Solo a narrative reason to repair fractured relationships while escalating the threat posed by Royce Keys and 946.

stories.title: Thea Hail Set For WWE NXT Women's NA Title Match
stories.tldr: Thea Hail has earned a shot at the WWE NXT Women's North American Championship and will challenge Zaria on next week's episode of NXT. Hail secured the opportunity after pinning Zaria during a tag team match that also featured La Catalina and Kelani Jordan. Hail has been eager to regain the championship ever since her short-lived initial reign ended in January. Meanwhile, Zaria enters the matchup defending a dominant reign that has lasted over 100 days following her victory over Tatum Paxley in June.

stories.title: Dorian Van Dux Sidelined With Punctured Lung in WWE NXT Ahead of Dusty Classic
stories.tldr: Dorian Van Dux is sidelined from WWE NXT action after suffering a punctured lung, placing his spot in the upcoming Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic in doubt. During a recent episode, Sean Legacy revealed the injury backstage and rightfully shot down Van Dux's insistence on wrestling anyway. EK Prosper stepped in as a replacement for that night's six-man tag team match alongside Legacy and Zilla Fatu. Unfortunately, the makeshift trio ultimately lost to BirthRight when Uriah Connors pinned Sean Legacy.

stories.title: First two teams advance in Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The 2024 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic has officially kicked off with the first two teams securing their spots in the next round during a recent event in Orlando. Romeo Moreno and Noam Dar defeated Los Americanos, while The Creed Brothers triumphed over Harley Riggins and Jax Presley of Evolve. The tournament features a diverse lineup from NXT, the main roster, AAA, and Evolve, with several powerhouse teams already waiting in the second round via byes. Action will continue next week with more crucial opening-round matchups.

stories.title: Bully Ray Calls Cody Rhodes’ SmackDown Interview ‘Polished and Soulless’
stories.tldr: Veteran wrestling personality Bully Ray recently criticized Cody Rhodes and his recent SmackDown interview with Michael Cole for feeling overly rehearsed and artificial. Speaking on radio, Bully explained that the immaculate suit, precise lighting, and measured delivery made the segment feel soulless when the storyline called for genuine frustration over recent betrayals. In contrast, he praised a supplementary clip showing a more ruthless side of Rhodes, though he questioned why management officially released the supposedly private moment. He concluded that WWE now needs to provide an on-screen explanation for why Rhodes would confront management over broadcasting the candid footage.

stories.title: WWE NXT Championship Match Set for September 29 After Heated Face-Off
stories.tldr: The NXT Championship match between champion Grayson Waller and challenger Mason Rook is officially set for the September 29 episode after a heated face-off on September 22. During their confrontation, Waller alternated between praising Rook and launching personal attacks, even dragging John Cena into the mix. Waller ultimately vowed to drown Rook and make him quit in next week's highly personal title showdown.

stories.title: NXT Star Returns After Two-Month TV Absence, Costs Kali Armstrong the Match
stories.tldr: Reina Volcan made her return to WWE NXT television on September 22 after a nearly two-month absence, disrupting a match between Kali Armstrong and Skylar Raye. Although she had stayed active on house shows and previously teased the beginning of the Volcan Era on social media, she made her on-screen statement by attacking both competitors while the referee was incapacitated. The chaos ultimately allowed Raye to capitalize and secure the tainted victory over Armstrong, signaling a violent and chaotic new chapter in the NXT women's division.

stories.title: Noam Dar & Romeo Moreno Advance as Cody Rhodes Gets Dusty Classic Role
stories.tldr: The 2026 Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic has officially kicked off on NXT, featuring a 14-team single-elimination tournament with talent from WWE and AAA. Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno secured the first spot in the next round by defeating Los Americanos in a hard-fought opening match. Meanwhile, The Creed Brothers also advanced with a pinfall victory over Harley Riggins and Jax Presley. Additionally, Cody Rhodes appeared in a special video package to announce that he will personally present the tournament trophy to the winning team at the conclusion of the event.

stories.title: Romeo Moreno, Noam Dar, And More Advance In WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The 2026 WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic officially kicked off with the first round matchups taking place on television. Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno secured a hard-fought victory over Los Americanos to move forward in the tournament. Meanwhile, the Creed Brothers also advanced to the next round after defeating the WWE EVOLVE team of Jax Presley and Harley Riggins. Both winning teams now await the outcome of upcoming matches to determine their next opponents in the bracket.

stories.title: Second Team Advances in WWE NXT Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic
stories.tldr: The Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic field narrowed further during the September 22, 2026 episode of NXT as The Creed Brothers advanced to the next round. Julius and Brutus Creed overcame a tough challenge from Harley Riggins and Jax Presley, recovering from a momentary miscommunication during the match. They join Noam Dar and Romeo Moreno as the second team to officially secure their spot in the tournament. Fans are now discussing whether the powerhouse duo has what it takes to go all the way and claim the trophy.

stories.title: WWE NXT injury: Dorian Van Dux punctured lung hopefully won’t affect the Belgian’s impressive rise up the ranks
stories.tldr: Dorian Van Dux was ruled medically unable to compete on NXT due to a punctured lung, forcing him out of a scheduled six-man tag team match where EK Prosper replaced him alongside Sean Legacy and Zilla Fatu. Despite wanting to push through the injury, his partner Legacy insisted he follow medical advice to protect their status in the upcoming Dusty Rhodes Tag Team Classic. Van Dux and Legacy are considered among the favorites to win the entire tournament, where they are scheduled to face AAA's Tokyo Bad Boys in the first round. Fans and management alike are hoping for a quick recovery for the Belgian standout, whose impressive blend of power and speed has positioned him for a major breakout either as part of the tag division or as a future singles star.

stories.title: Oba Femi Isn’t Letting Bronson Reed’s WWE RAW Taunt Slide: ‘F— You’
stories.tldr: Oba Femi is seeking revenge against Bronson Reed after Reed disrespected him by placing a foot on his back during a recent attack on WWE RAW. Femi returned to the red brand on September 21 to clear the ring and directly challenge Reed to a one-on-one match with an explicit message. Both powerhouses acknowledge their intense rivalry stems from a mutual desire to be the top dog in the company.

stories.title: JBL Recalls Vince McMahon Making Booker T Apologize for a Joke McMahon Supplied
stories.tldr: Former WWE star JBL recently shared a bizarre backstage story on the Something to Wrestle podcast involving Vince McMahon and Booker T. According to JBL, McMahon fed Booker a potentially offensive dad joke to use on air, but then forgot he was the one who supplied it after someone backstage complained. Booker was subsequently forced to issue an apology for the line, which he accepted professionally without arguing with McMahon. The anecdote highlighted the intense and chaotic nature of McMahon's production style in Gorilla position while overseeing the broadcast team.

stories.title: Cody Rhodes’ Street Fighter Shoot Was Interrupted by a Huge Family Moment
stories.tldr: While filming the upcoming live-action Street Fighter movie where he stars as Guile, Cody Rhodes received the news that his second daughter had been born. He found out while lying on the ground during a scene where his character was taken out by Bison's crew. Despite the chaotic and humorous interruption of a co-star flatulating while everyone had to pretend to be dead, Rhodes kept his composure before quietly sharing the news and celebrating with a cigar on set.

stories.title: WWE Hall of Famer Announces New Podcast Ahead of Movie About His Iconic Character
stories.tldr: WWE Hall of Famer Sgt. Slaughter has announced a new monthly podcast titled That is An Order, which premieres on YouTube through the Golden Era Network. Co-hosted by Robert Remus and Marcus, the show will feature fan Q and As and career retrospectives covering his time in the WWF, AWA, Mid-Atlantic, and pop culture as a G.I. Joe character. This announcement comes shortly after Remus revealed that a live-action movie titled Slaughter: The Origin Story is currently in development. Remus is serving as an executive producer for the film, which will focus on a younger version of his iconic persona and fictional military background.

stories.title: Trick Williams’ Controversial T-Shirt Still Available After WWE Pull
stories.tldr: WWE quickly pulled Trick Williams and his controversial Lemon Pepper Steppers T-shirt from its United States online store following online criticism regarding racially insensitive imagery. The shirt, which featured a white shoe paired with lemon pepper chicken wings, was removed in less than twenty-four hours after going on sale on September 21. Despite the domestic removal, the merchandise remains available for purchase as a pre-order on the WWE Euroshop and other international regional storefronts. Neither WWE nor Williams has publicly commented on the controversy as Fanatics and WWE work to address the remaining regional listings.

stories.title: Janel Grant Describes The Aftermath Of Vince McMahon Allegations Becoming Public
